items.s: She gave me ___.
a: a few pieces of useful advice
items.exp: advice는 불가산이라 piece로 세요. 여러 개이므로 pieces를 쓰고 advice 자체는 복수형으로 쓰지 않아요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 나에게 몇 가지 유용한 조언을 해 주었다.
items.hint: a few로 시작, (piece, useful, advice) 활용, 6단어

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The news of their wedding [were] a big surprise to all of us. → ___
items.exp: news는 -s로 끝나지만 단수 취급하는 명사라 was예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The cattle ___ grass in the field now.
items.exp: cattle은 항상 복수 취급하고 now가 있으므로 현재진행형 are eating이에요.
items.ctx: 소 떼가 지금 들판에서 풀을 먹고 있다.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: There [are] little furniture in his new apartment. → ___
items.exp: furniture는 불가산명사라 단수 취급해요. There is little furniture가 맞아요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He bought ___ and two bottles of milk last week.
items.exp: bread는 물질명사라 loaf로 세고, loaf의 복수형은 loaves예요.
items.ctx: 그는 지난주에 빵 세 덩어리와 우유 두 병을 샀다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The new teacher answered every question with confident.
The rule is of great importance to all players.
He broke the window by accident while playing.
She was all ears when I told her the secret.
The Parks are planning a trip to Busan.
items.exp: with+추상명사가 부사 역할을 하므로 형용사 confident가 아니라 명사 confidence를 써야 해요(with confidence = confidently).

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: This dictionary is of greatly use to students.
She solved the puzzle with easy.
The children were all smile when they saw the clown.
A Kims moved into the house next door.
The little girl was kindness itself to the new student.
items.exp: 추상명사+itself(= very kind)는 옳아요. of great use(형용사 great), with ease(명사), all smiles(복수), 성 앞의 The ~s(The Kims)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: To my surprise, the shy boy won the speech contest.
She made friends with a girl from Canada.
It is of very important to wear a seat belt.
The horse is a useful animal.
We should handle the old books with care.
items.exp: of+추상명사가 형용사 역할을 하므로 of 뒤에는 명사가 와야 해요. of very important → of great importance (또는 very important).

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: He made friend with his new classmates.
The Lee are going to move to Daegu.
The movie was of interested to young people.
He shook hands with the new coach after the game.
He didn't break the vase in purpose.
items.exp: shake hands with는 상대와 손을 주고받으므로 복수 hands가 옳아요. make friends with, The Lees, of interest, on purpose로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The book was of no help to me at all.
(b) He spoke to the guests with politeness.
(c) She was all attention during the lecture.
(d) He finished the work in hastily.
(e) The Browns has lived on this street for years.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: of no help = not helpful. (b) 옳음: with politeness = politely. (c) 옳음: all+추상명사 = 매우 주의 깊은. (d) 틀림: 전치사 뒤에는 명사 → in haste. (e) 틀림: The+성+s(~씨 부부/가족)는 복수 → have. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) She was beauty itself in her wedding dress.
(b) He had the kindness to carry my heavy bag.
(c) The meeting is of great important to us.
(d) A whale is a mammal, not a fish.
(e) The players listened to the coach with attentive.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 추상명사+itself = very beautiful. (b) 옳음: have the kindness to ~ = 친절하게도 ~하다. (c) 틀림: of 뒤엔 명사 → of great importance. (d) 옳음: a+단수명사로 종족 전체를 대표. (e) 틀림: with 뒤엔 명사 → with attention. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) To our joy, the lost cat came back home.
(b) This old coin is of little value.
(c) She was all smiles after the game.
(d) He drove the car with care on the icy road.
(e) The Kims is coming to dinner tonight.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: to one's+감정명사 = ~하게도. (b) 옳음: of little value = 거의 가치가 없는. (c) 옳음: all+복수명사 = 매우 ~한. (d) 옳음: with care = carefully. (e) 틀림: The Kims(김 씨 가족)는 복수 → are. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The man was honesty itself.
(b) She did her homework in haste.
(c) This map will be of useful to you.
(d) The boys were all eyes as the magician did his trick.
(e) He hurt his friend's feelings by purpose.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 추상명사+itself = very honest. (b) 옳음: in haste = hastily. (c) 틀림: of 뒤엔 명사 → of use. (d) 옳음: all eyes = 눈을 크게 뜨고 주목하는. (e) 틀림: '일부러'는 on purpose. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Fresh water is of great importance to all living things.
(b) I shook hand with the mayor.
(c) The dolphin is a very smart animal.
(d) He answered the phone in a hurry.
(e) To his surprise, his son passed the exam with easily.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: of great importance = very important. (b) 틀림: 상호복수 → shook hands with. (c) 옳음: the+단수명사로 종족 전체를 대표. (d) 옳음: in a hurry = 서둘러. (e) 틀림: with 뒤엔 명사 → with ease. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) A cat likes to sleep in warm places.
(b) The cat is a clever animal.
(c) Cats like to sleep in warm places.
(d) The cats is a clever animal.
(e) Cat likes warm places.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: a+단수명사로 종족 대표. (b) 옳음: the+단수명사로 종족 대표. (c) 옳음: 무관사 복수명사로 종족 대표. (d) 틀림: the cats는 복수라 is와 맞지 않고 종족 대표로도 쓰지 않아요 → The cat is. (e) 틀림: 셀 수 있는 단수명사는 관사 없이 쓸 수 없어요 → A cat / Cats like. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• This old map will be (A) ___ great help to travelers.
• He knocked over the vase (B) ___ accident.
items.exp: of+추상명사(of great help = very helpful)가 형용사 역할을 하고, '우연히'는 by accident예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The kids were all (A) ___ when they opened their gifts.
• She treated the old dog with (B) ___.
items.exp: all+복수명사 all smiles(매우 즐거운), with+추상명사 with kindness(= kindly)라서 둘 다 명사가 와야 해요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> He opened the old box [with care].
choices: She cut the cake [with a knife].
The girl [with long hair] is my sister.
I went to the park [with my dog].
We stayed home [with nothing to do].
He answered the difficult question [with ease].
items.exp: <보기>의 with care는 with+추상명사로 부사(carefully) 역할이에요. with ease(= easily)가 같고, 나머지는 도구·명사 수식·동반·부대상황이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> His advice was [of great value] to me.
choices: The information was [of no use] to us.
Most [of the students] passed the test.
He is very proud [of his son].
The roof [of the house] is red.
items.exp: <보기>의 of great value는 of+추상명사로 형용사(very valuable) 역할을 하는 보어예요. of no use(= useless)가 같고, 나머지는 부분·대상·소속·재료를 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: This book ___ to beginners.
items.exp: of+추상명사는 형용사 역할을 해요. of great use = very useful이고 주어가 단수라 is예요.
items.ctx: 이 책은 초보자들에게 매우 유용하다.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He solved the problem ___.
items.exp: with+추상명사는 부사 역할을 해요. easily = with ease예요.
items.ctx: He solved the problem easily.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The audience was all [ear] during her speech. → ___
items.exp: '열심히 귀 기울이는'은 all+복수명사로 all ears라고 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: She was ___ to everyone.
items.exp: 추상명사+itself는 'very+형용사'의 뜻이에요. very kind = kindness itself예요.
items.ctx: She was very kind to everyone.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: ___ in this town for ten years.
items.exp: '브라운 씨 부부(가족)'는 The+성+s로 복수 취급하고, for ten years는 현재완료와 써서 have lived예요.
items.ctx: 브라운 씨 부부는 10년 동안 이 동네에 살아 왔다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: ___, he made the mistake on purpose.
items.exp: to one's+감정명사는 '~하게도'의 뜻이에요. 놀랍게도 = To my surprise예요.
items.ctx: (내가) 놀랍게도, 그는 그 실수를 일부러 했다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She is a university student in Seoul.
He caught the thief by the collar.
It was so a nice day that we went on a picnic.
We have English class three times a week.
The Netherlands is famous for its tulips.
items.exp: so는 'so+형용사+a+명사' 어순이에요. so a nice day → so nice a day (또는 such a nice day). university는 /j/ 발음으로 시작해 a가 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She goes to school by the bus.
We had a lunch at noon in the park.
Sun is much bigger than the moon.
Half a hour is enough for the test.
It was quite an interesting story.
items.exp: quite는 'quite+a(n)+형용사+명사' 어순이라 옳아요. by bus(교통수단 무관사), had lunch(식사 무관사), The sun(유일한 것), half an hour로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The Alps are covered with snow all year.
Most people go to bed before midnight.
This is very the book I've been looking for.
Jiho was the first student to arrive this morning.
My father goes to church every Sunday.
items.exp: '바로 그'를 뜻하는 very는 the 뒤에 와서 the very book이 돼요. 산맥 the Alps, 본래 목적의 go to bed·go to church, 서수 앞 the는 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: He is too an honest man to lie.
All the students in the room stood up.
We play the soccer every Saturday.
items.exp: all은 the 앞에 와서 all the students가 옳아요. too honest a man, 언어 Spanish·운동 soccer는 무관사, both the brothers 어순이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I usually have breakfast at seven.
(b) The tiger is in danger of dying out.
(c) My brother is an university student.
(d) He grabbed his son by the hand.
(e) The poor need more help from society.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 식사 이름 앞엔 관사 없음. (b) 옳음: the+단수명사로 종족 전체를 대표. (c) 틀림: university는 자음 /j/로 시작 → a university. (d) 옳음: 동사+사람+전치사+the+신체 부위. (e) 옳음: the+형용사 = ~한 사람들(복수). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Such a cold day is rare in April.
(b) How a kind girl she is!
(c) He is paid by the week.
(d) Can you play the guitar?
(e) The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: such+a+형용사+명사 어순. (b) 틀림: How+형용사+a+명사 → How kind a girl she is!. (c) 옳음: by the+단위 = ~ 단위로. (d) 옳음: 악기 앞에는 the. (e) 옳음: 대양 이름 앞 the, 최상급 앞 the. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Sugar is sold by a kilogram here.
(b) I go to the dentist once the month.
(c) The moon goes around the earth.
(d) He is as tall a boy as his brother.
(e) What beautiful a day it is!
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 단위는 by the → by the kilogram. (b) 틀림: '~마다'는 a → once a month. (c) 옳음: 유일한 천체 앞의 the. (d) 옳음: as+형용사+a+명사+as 어순. (e) 틀림: What+a+형용사+명사 → What a beautiful day. 따라서 옳은 것은 (c), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I bought a cap and a scarf, but the cap was too small.
(b) Let's play baseball after school.
(c) She is a honest woman.
(d) Birds of a feather flock together.
(e) The Seoul is the capital of Korea.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 앞에 나온 명사를 다시 말할 때 the. (b) 옳음: 운동 이름 무관사, 본래 목적의 school. (c) 틀림: honest는 모음 발음으로 시작 → an honest. (d) 옳음: a = the same(같은). (e) 틀림: 도시 이름엔 관사 없음 → Seoul. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She looked me in the eye.
(b) I usually go to work by a car.
(c) It's a too difficult question for me.
(d) The wounded were taken to the hospital.
(e) Do you know the girl who is standing over there?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동사+사람+in the+신체 부위. (b) 틀림: by+교통수단은 무관사 → by car. (c) 틀림: too+형용사+a+명사 → too difficult a question. (d) 옳음: the+분사 = ~한 사람들(복수). (e) 옳음: 수식어로 한정된 명사 앞 the. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) An honest man doesn't tell lies.
(b) She is the most popular singer in Korea.
(c) I'll be back in half an hour.
(d) Mike is the taller of the two boys.
(e) He has visited a Europe twice.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: honest의 h는 묵음 → an. (b) 옳음: 최상급 앞 the. (c) 옳음: half an hour 어순, hour는 모음 발음. (d) 옳음: of the two가 있으면 비교급 앞에 the. (e) 틀림: 대륙 이름엔 관사 없음 → Europe. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• My uncle works for (A) ___ European company.
• The singer has (B) ___ unique voice.
items.exp: 관사는 철자가 아닌 발음으로 정해요. European, unique는 모두 자음 /j/ 발음으로 시작하므로 둘 다 a예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• Eggs are sold by (A) ___ dozen at this market.
• She caught her brother by (B) ___ arm.
items.exp: '~ 단위로'는 by the+단위(by the dozen), '사람의 신체 부위를 잡다'는 동사+사람+by the+신체 부위로 소유격이 아닌 the를 써요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> We go swimming twice [a] week.
choices: [A] Mr. Choi wants to see you.
Rome was not built in [a] day.
She is [a] teacher at my school.
Tom and I are of [an] age.
I wash my car twice [a] month.
items.exp: <보기>의 a는 '~마다(per)'의 뜻이에요. twice a month가 같고, 나머지는 '어떤', '하나의', 직업 분류, '같은'의 뜻이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [The] rich are not always happy.
choices: [The] young should listen to the old.
He is [the] tallest boy in his class.
items.exp: <보기>의 The는 'the+형용사 = ~한 사람들'이에요. The young(젊은이들)이 같고, 나머지는 유일한 것, 상황상 아는 것, 최상급, 악기 앞의 the예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: It was ___ that nobody could answer it.
items.exp: such는 'such+a+형용사+명사' 어순이라 such a difficult question이에요.
items.ctx: 그것은 너무 어려운 질문이어서 아무도 답할 수 없었다.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He was ___.
items.exp: so를 쓰면 'so+형용사+a+명사' 어순이 되어 so kind a boy예요.
items.ctx: He was such a kind boy.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I meet my piano teacher twice [the] week. → ___
items.exp: '~마다, ~당'의 뜻은 부정관사 a로 나타내요. twice a week예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The teacher patted ___.
items.exp: '사람의 신체 부위를 두드리다'는 동사+사람+on the+신체 부위로, 소유격 대신 the를 써요.
items.ctx: 선생님은 그 학생의 어깨를 두드렸다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The shop rents out bikes ___.
items.exp: '~ 단위로'는 by the+단위명사예요.
items.ctx: 그 가게는 시간 단위로 자전거를 빌려 준다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: We ___ after breakfast.
items.exp: 학교에 공부하러 가는 것은 본래 목적이라 무관사 school, by+교통수단도 무관사예요. 과거이므로 went예요.
items.ctx: 우리는 아침 식사 후 버스를 타고 학교에 갔다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It took me three days to read the novel.
The weather in Busan is warmer than those in Seoul.
I think it wrong to tell lies to your friends.
It was on Monday that the package arrived.
It is getting colder and colder these days.
items.exp: 앞의 단수명사 the weather를 대신하므로 those가 아니라 that을 써야 해요. 가목적어 it, 강조구문, 비인칭 it은 모두 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I found difficult to finish the work alone.
It was my sister which baked these cookies.
It cost to him a lot of money to fix the car.
That is necessary for you to exercise every day.
She makes it a rule to read the news every morning.
items.exp: make it a rule to ~(가목적어 it)는 옳아요. found it difficult to, 사람 강조는 who/that, It cost him ~(to 없음), 가주어는 It으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: It seems that the shop is closed today.
She seems to have caught a cold last week.
He seems that he is very tired today.
It is said that the old tree is 500 years old.
The streets in this city are cleaner than those in my hometown.
items.exp: seem that 구문은 가주어 It으로 시작해야 해요. He seems to be very tired today 또는 It seems that he is very tired today로 고쳐요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: It was at the station what I met her.
It takes thirty minutes walk to school.
I made it clearly that I disagreed with him.
It was not until midnight that he came home.
It was kind for her to help the old man.
items.exp: It was not until ~ that 강조구문은 옳아요. 강조구문은 that, It takes 시간 to walk, 목적격보어는 형용사 clear, 성격 형용사 kind 뒤 의미상 주어는 of her로 고쳐요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It is not easy for me to speak in front of many people.
(b) It is kind for you to say so.
(c) We thought it strange that he didn't call us.
(d) It was Jisu that won first prize in the contest.
(e) It took two hours for us to clean the house.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가주어 it, 의미상 주어 for me. (b) 틀림: 사람의 성격 형용사 뒤 의미상 주어는 of → of you. (c) 옳음: 가목적어 it, 진목적어 that절. (d) 옳음: It ~ that 강조구문. (e) 옳음: It takes 시간 for 사람 to ~. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The population of China is larger than that of Korea.
(b) My shoes are more expensive than that of my brother.
(c) He found it hard to make new friends at school.
(d) It was in the kitchen that I dropped the glass.
(e) It seems that he knew the answer.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 단수 the population을 that으로 받아요. (b) 틀림: 복수 shoes를 받으므로 → those. (c) 옳음: 가목적어 it. (d) 옳음: 부사구를 강조하는 It ~ that. (e) 옳음: It seems that+과거시제 가능. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It is likely that it will rain tomorrow.
(b) She seemed to be angry with us.
(c) It is time you went to bed.
(d) It took for me an hour to finish it.
(e) I consider that my duty to help others.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가주어 It과 비인칭 it. (b) 옳음: seem to부정사. (c) 옳음: It is time+과거동사(가정법). (d) 틀림: It took me an hour 또는 It took an hour for me. (e) 틀림: 가목적어는 it → consider it my duty. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It is dangerous to swim alone in the sea at night.
(b) What was it that made you so angry?
(c) I make it a rule exercising every morning.
(d) He seems to have lived in Japan when he was young.
(e) It is the students that has to clean the classroom.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가주어 It, 진주어 to부정사. (b) 옳음: 의문사를 강조하는 It ~ that 구문. (c) 틀림: 진목적어는 to부정사 → to exercise. (d) 옳음: 과거의 일은 완료부정사. (e) 틀림: 강조된 주어 students에 일치 → have to. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was not easy to find the hidden key.
(b) It is necessary for students to wear uniforms.
(c) She found it impossible finishing the work on time.
(d) It's two miles from here to the beach.
(e) The price of apples is higher than those of bananas.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가주어 It. (b) 옳음: 의미상 주어 for students. (c) 틀림: 진목적어는 to부정사 → to finish. (d) 옳음: 거리를 나타내는 비인칭 it. (e) 틀림: 단수 the price를 받으므로 → that. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It seems that they were angry with me.
(b) They seem to have been angry with me.
(c) They seem to be angry with me yesterday.
(d) They seemed being angry.
(e) They seem that they are angry.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 지금 보기에 그때 화났던 것 같다. (b) 옳음: (a)를 완료부정사로 바꾼 문장. (c) 틀림: yesterday는 과거 → to have been. (d) 틀림: seem 뒤에는 to부정사 → to be angry. (e) 틀림: seem that은 가주어 It으로 → It seems that. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The climate here is milder than (A) ___ of my hometown.
• The rooms in this hotel are bigger than (B) ___ in that one.
items.exp: 단수 the climate는 that으로, 복수 the rooms는 those로 받아요. 뒤에 수식어(of ~, in ~)가 있을 때 it/them은 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I found (A) ___ hard to believe his story.
• It was in 2020 (B) ___ our school was built.
items.exp: (A)는 진목적어 to believe ~를 대신하는 가목적어 it, (B)는 부사구 in 2020을 강조하는 It ~ that 구문의 that이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 It(it)과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [It] is hard to learn a new language.
choices: I found [it] easy to use this app.
[It] was Mina that broke the window.
I lost my pen, and I can't find [it].
[It] is important that we keep our promises.
items.exp: <보기>의 It은 to부정사를 대신하는 가주어예요. that절을 대신하는 가주어 It이 같고, 나머지는 비인칭·가목적어·강조구문·인칭대명사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 It과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [It] was in the park that I found the lost puppy.
choices: [It] was yesterday that she called me.
[It] is certain that he will come.
[It] was so dark that we couldn't see anything.
[It] is a pity that you can't join us.
[It] was a long book, but I enjoyed it.
items.exp: <보기>는 부사구를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문이에요. yesterday를 강조한 문장이 같고, 나머지는 가주어·비인칭(명암)·가주어·인칭대명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: It ___ to solve the puzzle.
items.exp: '(사람)이 ~하는 데 (시간)이 걸리다'는 It takes+사람+시간+to부정사이고, 과거이므로 took예요.
items.ctx: 내가 그 퍼즐을 푸는 데 두 시간이 걸렸다.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: She ___ rich when she was young.
items.exp: 주절(seems, 현재)보다 앞선 과거 일이므로 완료부정사 to have been을 써요.
items.ctx: It seems that she was rich when she was young.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I think [that] important to keep a diary every day. → ___
items.exp: 진목적어 to keep ~를 대신하는 가목적어는 that이 아니라 it을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: ___ broke the window.
items.exp: 주어 the cat을 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문이에요. 사물이므로 that 대신 which도 가능해요.
items.ctx: 그 창문을 깬 것은 바로 그 고양이였다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: It's time ___ the truth.
items.exp: It's time 뒤에 주어+과거동사를 쓰면 '이제 ~할 때이다(그런데 안 하고 있다)'라는 가정법 표현이 돼요.
items.ctx: 이제 네가 진실을 말해야 할 때이다.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: It was at the mall ___ her old friend last Saturday.
items.exp: 장소 부사구 at the mall을 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문이에요. 나머지 부분은 원래 어순과 시제(met)를 그대로 써요.
items.ctx: Mina met her old friend at the mall last Saturday.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Each of the boys on the team have a different number.
Neither of the answers is correct.
Both of my parents work at a hospital.
None of the milk was spilled.
Every three hours, the nurse checks the patient.
items.exp: each of+복수명사는 단수 취급하므로 have → has예요. on the team에 속지 마세요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: There were three boxes. One was red, and the others was blue.
Some like rock music, and the other like jazz.
These cookies are delicious. Can I have other?
Every two week, we go hiking in the mountains.
I have two brothers; one is a pilot, and the other is a chef.
items.exp: 둘 중 하나는 one, 나머지 하나는 the other예요. the others were, others like, another, every two weeks로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: All of the money was spent on food.
Either of the two buses goes to the station.
These shoes are too tight. Do you have bigger one?
The two girls helped each other with homework.
Some of the students were late for class.
items.exp: 앞의 복수명사 shoes를 대신하므로 ones를 써야 해요 → bigger ones. 불가산 money를 받은 All은 단수 was가 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: Both of the answer is wrong.
All was surprised at the news.
He has five pens. One is red, and other are black.
Every fifth day, he goes to the library.
None of the information were helpful.
items.exp: every+서수+단수명사(every fifth day)는 옳아요. Both of the answers are, 사람을 뜻하는 All은 복수 were, 나머지 전부는 the others, 불가산 information은 was예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) One of the students has a cold.
(b) Each girl was given a flower.
(c) Every member of the team has to attend the meeting.
(d) Both of them is good at math.
(e) All of the cake was eaten.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: one of+복수명사는 단수 취급. (b) 옳음: each+단수명사, 단수 동사. (c) 옳음: every+단수명사는 단수 취급. (d) 틀림: both는 복수 → are. (e) 옳음: all of+불가산(한 덩어리)은 단수. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Some people like cats; others like dogs.
(b) I have three cousins. One lives in Seoul, another in Busan, and the other in Jeju.
(c) Knowing is one thing; teaching is the other.
(d) We see each other every weekend.
(e) Every student have to wear a name tag.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 막연한 일부 some ~ 다른 일부 others. (b) 옳음: 셋 중 하나 one, 또 하나 another, 마지막 하나 the other. (c) 틀림: A is one thing, B is another → another. (d) 옳음: each other = 서로. (e) 틀림: every+단수명사는 단수 → has to. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Neither of the two roads leads to the beach.
(b) Either days is fine with me.
(c) None of the furniture was new.
(d) Of the ten students, two passed and the others failed.
(e) I don't like this color. Show me other one.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: neither of ~는 단수 취급. (b) 틀림: either 뒤엔 단수명사 → Either day. (c) 옳음: none of+불가산명사는 단수. (d) 옳음: 정해진 나머지 전부는 the others. (e) 틀림: 또 다른 하나는 another (one). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She has two dogs. One is white, and the other is brown.
(b) There are five apples. One is mine, and the other are yours.
(c) Some students walk to school; others take the bus.
(d) Each of us have a different dream.
(e) My old laptop broke, so I bought a new one.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 둘 중 one ~ the other. (b) 틀림: 나머지 여럿 전부는 → the others. (c) 옳음: some ~ others. (d) 틀림: each of ~는 단수 → has. (e) 옳음: 같은 종류의 다른 물건은 one. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The Olympic Games are held every four years.
(b) Every other day, she waters the flowers.
(c) Every two weeks, the club meets.
(d) Every third months, I get a haircut.
(e) Every child need a lot of love.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: every+기수+복수명사. (b) 옳음: every other day = 이틀마다. (c) 옳음: every+기수+복수명사. (d) 틀림: every+서수+단수명사 → every third month. (e) 틀림: every+단수명사는 단수 → needs. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) All of the students were excited.
(b) All of the water was gone.
(c) Both the movie and the book was popular.
(d) Neither of the plans was accepted.
(e) Each of the rooms has its own bathroom.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: all of+복수명사는 복수. (b) 옳음: all of+불가산명사는 단수. (c) 틀림: both A and B는 복수 → were. (d) 옳음: neither of ~는 단수. (e) 옳음: each of ~는 단수, 소유격 its. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I have three hats. One is black, (A) ___ is white, and the other is gray.
• Some people enjoy winter, while (B) ___ hate the cold.
items.exp: 셋 중 두 번째는 another, 마지막은 the other예요. 막연한 사람들 중 일부(some)와 다른 일부는 others예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• (A) ___ of the two answers is right; both are wrong.
• (B) ___ student in this class has a laptop.
items.exp: 둘 다 틀렸으므로 '둘 중 어느 것도 ~ 아니다'의 Neither, 단수명사 student와 단수 동사 has 앞에는 Every예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• My phone is too old. I want to buy a new (A) ___.
• These pants are too short. Do you have longer (B) ___?
items.exp: 같은 종류의 다른 물건은 one, 복수명사 pants를 대신할 때는 ones예요. it/them은 바로 그 물건을 가리켜요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 one과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I don't have a pencil. Can you lend me [one]?
choices: This bag is too small. Show me a bigger [one].
[One] day, the old man left the town.
[One] of my friends lives in Busan.
items.exp: <보기>의 one은 앞에 나온 가산명사(a pencil)를 대신하는 부정대명사예요. a bigger one(= a bigger bag)이 같고, 나머지는 일반인, 수사 '하나의', '어느', '~ 중 하나'의 뜻이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: I have two uncles. One is a doctor, and ___ a teacher.
items.exp: 둘 중 하나는 one, 나머지 하나는 the other이고 단수이므로 is예요.
items.ctx: 나에게는 삼촌이 두 분 있다. 한 분은 의사이고, 다른 한 분은 교사이다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: Some students walk to school, and ___ to school by bike.
items.exp: 막연한 일부 some에 대해 '다른 일부'는 others이고, 복수이며 습관이므로 go예요.
items.ctx: 어떤 학생들은 걸어서 등교하고, 다른 학생들은 자전거로 등교한다.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Each of the players [were] given a new uniform. → ___
items.exp: each of+복수명사는 단수 취급해서 was예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: This shirt is too big. Could you show me ___?
items.exp: 같은 종류의 다른 셔츠를 가리키므로 one을 쓰고, 단수 가산명사이니 a smaller one이에요.
items.ctx: 이 셔츠는 너무 커요. 더 작은 것을 보여 주시겠어요?

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: ___ true.
items.exp: none of+불가산명사는 단수 취급하고 과거이므로 was예요.
items.ctx: 그 정보 중 어느 것도 사실이 아니었다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The bus comes ___.
items.exp: every+기수+복수명사로 '~마다'를 나타내요.
items.ctx: 그 버스는 20분마다 온다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Those who exercise every morning and eat well is usually healthy.
The sound of the guitar is softer than that of the drum.
Please help yourselves to the drinks, everyone.
She made the cake by herself.
items.exp: 주어 Those(~하는 사람들)는 복수라서 is → are예요. 관계사절이 길어 동사가 멀리 떨어져 있어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He doesn't know nothing about the plan.
Those which live near the sea love seafood.
The idea in itself are good.
I didn't see anyone in the classroom.
items.exp: 부정문에서는 anyone을 써요. 이중부정 → anything, ourselves, 사람은 Those who, The idea는 단수라 is로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: Not every student passed the test.
The weather in Seoul is colder than that in Jeju.
The children don't have no time to play these days.
I don't necessarily agree with you.
She talked to herself while cooking.
items.exp: not과 no를 함께 쓰면 이중부정이 돼요. don't have any time 또는 have no time으로 고쳐요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: Those who has a ticket can enter the hall.
The boys enjoyed theirselves at the beach.
He didn't buy neither of the books.
The old man was beside himself with joy.
The ears of rabbits are longer than that of cats.
items.exp: beside oneself(제정신이 아닌)는 옳아요. Those who have, themselves, either of, 복수 The ears는 those로 받아야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Those who were late had to clean the room.
(b) I didn't like either of the two movies.
(c) Not everyone enjoys horror movies.
(d) She cut herself while cooking dinner.
(e) Help you to the cake, please.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: those who+복수 동사. (b) 옳음: not ~ either = 둘 다 아니다. (c) 옳음: 부분부정 not every-, 단수 동사. (d) 옳음: 주어와 목적어가 같으면 재귀대명사. (e) 틀림: help oneself to = ~을 마음껏 먹다 → yourself. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I have no money with me.
(b) There isn't nothing in the box.
(c) The food in this restaurant is better than that in the hotel.
(d) The boys were proud of themselves.
(e) Those who lives near the river worry about floods.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: no = not any. (b) 틀림: 이중부정 → There isn't anything / There is nothing. (c) 옳음: 단수 the food를 that으로. (d) 옳음: 주어 The boys = 목적어 → themselves. (e) 틀림: those는 복수 → live. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He himself answered the phone.
(b) He answered the phone himself.
(c) She lives in the big house by her.
(d) The plan itself isn't bad.
(e) Myself fixed the computer.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주어를 강조하는 재귀대명사. (b) 옳음: 강조용법은 문장 끝에도 올 수 있어요. (c) 틀림: '혼자'는 by oneself → by herself. (d) 옳음: 명사를 강조하는 itself. (e) 틀림: 재귀대명사는 주어 자리에 못 와요 → I (myself). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not all of the students were present.
(b) None of my friends came to the party.
(c) I don't know nothing about it.
(d) Neither of them came to see me.
(e) She didn't say anything.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부분부정 not all. (b) 옳음: 전체부정 none. (c) 틀림: 이중부정 → anything. (d) 옳음: 전체부정 neither. (e) 옳음: 부정문의 anything. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The roads in the city are wider than those in the country.
(b) Those who want to join us is welcome.
(c) We made the kite for ourselves.
(d) He was angry at hisself.
(e) The movie itself was boring, but the music was great.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 복수 the roads를 those로. (b) 틀림: those는 복수 → are. (c) 옳음: for oneself = 자기를 위해, 혼자 힘으로. (d) 틀림: 재귀대명사는 himself. (e) 옳음: 명사를 강조하는 itself. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Smart people don't always make good choices.
(b) Not every child likes candy.
(c) Not every children like candy.
(d) I don't want to go to neither place.
(e) She enjoyed herself at the concert.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부분부정 not always. (b) 옳음: every+단수명사, 단수 동사. (c) 틀림: every 뒤엔 단수명사 → every child likes. (d) 틀림: not과 neither 이중부정 → either place. (e) 옳음: enjoy oneself = 즐거운 시간을 보내다. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The tail of a fox is longer than (A) ___ of a rabbit.
• (B) ___ who arrive late will not be allowed in.
items.exp: 단수 the tail을 받는 것은 that이고, '~하는 사람들'은 Those who예요. 복수 동사 arrive와도 맞아요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I don't like (A) ___ of these two shirts.
• Make (B) ___ at home, Mr. Kim.
items.exp: 부정문(don't)에서 '둘 다 ~ 아니다'는 not ~ either이고, 한 사람에게 '편히 계세요'는 make yourself at home이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> She [herself] made this dress.
choices: He looked at [himself] in the mirror.
She lives by [herself] in the country.
I [myself] saw the accident on the corner.
items.exp: <보기>의 herself는 주어를 강조하는 강조용법이라 생략해도 문장이 성립해요. I myself가 같고, 나머지는 목적어 자리의 재귀용법이거나 관용 표현이라 생략할 수 없어요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분처럼 부분부정을 나타내는 것은?
<보기> [Not all] the students like the new rule.
choices: [None] of the students liked the rule.
items.exp: not+all/always/every/both는 '모두 ~인 것은 아니다'라는 부분부정이에요. not always가 같고, none·neither·no·never는 전체부정이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: ___ the class.
items.exp: not all은 '모두 ~인 것은 아니다'라는 부분부정이고, students가 복수라 like예요.
items.ctx: 모든 학생들이 그 수업을 좋아하는 것은 아니다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He soon got used to ___.
items.exp: be/get used to의 to는 전치사라 동명사 living을 쓰고, '혼자'는 by himself예요.
items.ctx: 그는 곧 혼자 사는 것에 익숙해졌다.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I didn't eat [nothing] for breakfast this morning. → ___
items.exp: didn't와 nothing을 함께 쓰면 이중부정이에요. 부정문에서는 anything을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The prices in this town are lower than ___ in the city.
items.exp: 비교 대상이 앞의 복수명사 the prices이므로 those로 받아요.
items.ctx: 이 마을의 물가는 그 도시의 물가보다 더 낮다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: We ___ at the party last night.
items.exp: enjoy oneself는 '즐거운 시간을 보내다'이고, 주어가 we이며 과거라 enjoyed ourselves예요.
items.ctx: 우리는 어젯밤 그 파티에서 즐거운 시간을 보냈다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: ___ could answer the question.
items.exp: '둘 중 어느 쪽도 ~ 않다'는 전체부정 neither of를 써요.
items.ctx: 그 둘 중 누구도 그 질문에 답할 수 없었다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The car needs to be washed before the trip.
She seems to have been worked at the bank for years.
He is said to have lived in Paris as a child.
I'd rather not talk about it now.
You had better not tell her the secret.
items.exp: 그녀가 '일한' 것이므로 능동이어야 해요. to have been worked → to have worked. 수동부정사 to be washed, 완료부정사 to have lived는 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: My parents let me to go camping alone.
I'd rather to stay home tonight.
She seems to be sick last week.
He wanted to be choosing as the leader.
The rumor turned out to have been made up by a student.
items.exp: 소문이 '지어낸' 것보다 앞선 일이고 수동이므로 완료수동부정사가 옳아요. let me go, would rather stay, to have been sick, to be chosen으로 고쳐요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: You may well be proud of your son.
I watched the leaves fall from the tree.
We cannot but to laugh at his funny face.
She had the mechanic check her car.
He did nothing but complain all day.
items.exp: cannot but 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. to laugh → laugh. may well, 지각동사·사역동사+원형부정사, do nothing but+원형은 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: I felt the house to shake during the earthquake.
He had his son to clean the garage.
She would rather walk than taking a bus.
The baby seems to be sleeping now.
This problem is too hard to be solve.
items.exp: 진행부정사 to be sleeping은 옳아요. 지각동사 felt the house shake, 사역동사 had his son clean, would rather A than B는 둘 다 원형(take), to be solved로 고쳐요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
She was seen to cross the road.
You may as well go home now.
I'd like to go, but I'm not able to.
Tell him not be late for the meeting.
items.exp: to부정사의 부정은 not to+동사원형이에요. not be → not to be. 문장 끝 to는 대부정사로 옳아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He seems to have lost his wallet yesterday.
(b) She is said to be a great singer when she was young.
(c) The work is expected to be finished by Friday.
(d) I heard someone to knock on the door.
(e) My mom made me wear a coat.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재보다 앞선 일은 완료부정사. (b) 틀림: 과거 일은 → to have been. (c) 옳음: 일이 '끝내지는' 것이라 수동부정사. (d) 틀림: 지각동사의 목적격보어는 원형 → knock. (e) 옳음: 사역동사 make+목적어+원형. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) You had better to leave now.
(b) I asked him not to tell anyone.
(c) She is likely to have forgotten the meeting.
(d) We'd rather stay here than go out.
(e) He let his dog run in the park.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: had better+동사원형 → leave. (b) 옳음: not to부정사. (c) 옳음: 완료부정사로 이미 잊은 일. (d) 옳음: would rather A than B, 둘 다 원형. (e) 옳음: 사역동사 let+목적어+원형. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The house appears to have been built a long time ago.
(b) I want to be invited to her party.
(c) The thief was seen run away.
(d) He seemed to be worrying about something.
(e) She had her hair cut yesterday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 완료수동부정사. (b) 옳음: 초대 '받는' 것이라 수동부정사. (c) 틀림: 지각동사 수동태는 to부정사 → to run. (d) 옳음: 진행부정사. (e) 옳음: 머리가 '잘리는' 것이라 과거분사 cut. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He is believed to have been injured in the accident.
(b) I would rather die than to give up.
(c) She seems to be knowing the answer.
(d) Let the children play outside.
(e) He was made to stay after school.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거의 수동은 완료수동부정사. (b) 틀림: than 뒤도 원형 → give up. (c) 틀림: know는 진행형 불가 → to know. (d) 옳음: let+목적어+원형. (e) 옳음: 사역동사 수동태는 to부정사. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I can't help but to smile at the baby.
(b) She told me not to worry.
(c) He seems to have been sick since last week.
(d) He was heard sing loudly.
(e) I didn't mean to hurt you.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: can't help but+원형 → smile. (b) 옳음: not to부정사. (c) 옳음: 지난주부터 지금까지 아팠던 것 같다 → 완료부정사. (d) 틀림: 지각동사 수동태 → to sing. (e) 옳음: mean to부정사. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The bridge is going to be built next year.
(b) She wants her room to be cleaned.
(c) He seems to have been worked hard.
(d) They are said to be working on a new project.
(e) I'd love to go, but I'm not allowed to.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 수동부정사 to be built. (b) 옳음: 방이 '청소되는' 것이라 수동부정사. (c) 틀림: 그가 '일한' 것이라 능동 → to have worked. (d) 옳음: 진행부정사. (e) 옳음: to만 남긴 대부정사. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• He is said (A) ___ a great athlete when he was young.
• I saw my brother (B) ___ the cookies.
items.exp: 말하는 시점(현재)보다 과거의 일이라 완료부정사 to have been, 지각동사 see의 목적격보어는 원형 eat이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The letter seems (A) ___ by mistake.
• You'd better (B) ___ it to anyone.
choices: to have been opened – not to show
to have opened – not to show
to have been opened – not show
items.exp: 편지는 '열린' 것이고 이미 일어난 일이라 완료수동부정사, had better의 부정은 had better not+원형이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• My parents won't let me (A) ___ out late.
• She was made (B) ___ the dishes by her mom.
items.exp: 사역동사 let+목적어+원형(stay), 사역동사 make의 수동태는 be made to부정사(to wash)예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He seems ___ last week.
items.exp: seems(현재)보다 앞선 과거의 일이므로 완료부정사 to have been ill이에요.
items.ctx: It seems that he was ill last week.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The problem is expected ___ soon.
items.exp: 문제는 '해결되는' 대상이므로 수동부정사 to be solved예요.
items.ctx: 그 문제는 곧 해결될 것으로 예상된다.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My dad had me [to wash] his car on Sunday. → ___
items.exp: 사역동사 have+목적어+동사원형이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: You ___ up so late.
items.exp: had better의 부정은 had better not+동사원형이에요.
items.ctx: 너는 그렇게 늦게까지 깨어 있지 않는 게 좋겠다.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The castle ___ 500 years ago.
a: is said to have been built
items.exp: 말하는 시점(현재)보다 앞선 일이고 성은 '지어진' 것이므로 완료수동부정사 to have been built예요.
items.ctx: It is said that the castle was built 500 years ago.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: She seems ___ for me at that time.
items.exp: 지금 보기에 과거(그때) 진행 중이던 일이므로 완료진행부정사 to have been waiting이에요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 그때 나를 기다리고 있었던 것 같다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She needs a pen to write and some paper to write on.
It was foolish of him to believe the stranger.
We found it easy to follow her directions.
He left early so as not to miss the train.
I don't know where to put this box.
items.exp: 펜'으로' 쓰는 것이므로 전치사 with가 필요해요. a pen to write → a pen to write with. paper to write on은 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Her goal is become a nurse in the future.
It is very careless for you to lose your bag again.
She went to the market in order buy vegetables.
The box was light enough for the child to carry.
items.exp: 형용사+enough+for+의미상 주어+to부정사는 옳아요. 보어 자리에는 to become이 와야 하고, careless는 of you, in order to buy, something cold to drink로 고쳐요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: My plan is to travel around the world.
He woke up only to find himself alone.
This river is dangerous to swim.
You are to finish this work by six.
It is necessary for us to save energy.
items.exp: 강'에서' 수영하는 것이므로 전치사 in이 필요해요(swim in this river). → dangerous to swim in. only to(결과), be to(의무)는 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: I have many friends to play.
It was wise for her to say no.
He was too tired walking any farther.
She must be very smart to solve the problem so quickly.
I found it hard believe his story.
items.exp: to solve는 판단의 근거(~하다니)를 나타내는 부사적 용법으로 옳아요. friends to play with, wise of her, too tired to walk, hard to believe로 고쳐요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I was glad to hear that you passed the exam.
(b) He promised not to be late again.
(c) There are a lot of things for us to do today.
(d) The room is too dark for us to read in.
(e) It is impossible of him to finish it alone.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 감정의 원인을 나타내는 부사적 용법. (b) 옳음: not to부정사. (c) 옳음: 형용사적 용법+의미상 주어 for us. (d) 옳음: 방 '안에서' 읽으므로 in, 주어와 같은 목적어는 생략. (e) 틀림: impossible은 성격 형용사가 아니므로 → for him. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) She has no house to live.
(b) The doctor told me what to eat.
(c) If you are to succeed, you must work hard.
(d) It is nice for you to help me.
(e) He studied hard only to fail the test.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 집 '안에' 사는 것 → to live in. (b) 옳음: 의문사+to부정사. (c) 옳음: if절의 be to는 의도(~하려면). (d) 틀림: 사람의 성격·태도 형용사 nice → of you. (e) 옳음: only to = 결국 ~하고 말았다(결과). 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The book is easy enough to read in a day.
(b) To be honest, I don't like the color.
(c) She was kind enough helping me.
(d) I decided not going to the party.
(e) The dog was too old to run fast.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 형용사+enough to부정사. (b) 옳음: 독립부정사 to be honest. (c) 틀림: enough 뒤엔 to부정사 → to help. (d) 틀림: decide는 to부정사 목적어 → not to go. (e) 옳음: too ~ to = 너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He needs someone to depend on.
(b) She has a lot of homework to do.
(c) I bought a chair to sit.
(d) We have nothing to talk.
(e) Give me a pen to write.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: depend on의 전치사를 남겨요. (b) 옳음: 형용사적 용법. (c) 틀림: 의자 '위에' 앉으므로 → to sit on. (d) 틀림: ~에 대해 이야기하므로 → to talk about. (e) 틀림: 펜'으로' 쓰므로 → to write with. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It's very generous of you to share your lunch.
(b) It's difficult of me to understand his words.
(c) It's important for children to drink milk.
(d) It was stupid for him to say that.
(e) It's thoughtful of you to call me.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 성격 형용사 generous → of you. (b) 틀림: difficult는 for+의미상 주어 → for me. (c) 옳음: important → for children. (d) 틀림: 성격 형용사 stupid → of him. (e) 옳음: 성격 형용사 thoughtful → of you. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The soup is too salty to eat.
(b) The soup is too salty to eat it.
(c) The soup is so salty that I can't eat it.
(d) He is old enough to drive a car.
(e) He is enough old to drive a car.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: too ~ to, 주어와 같은 목적어 생략. (b) 틀림: 주어 the soup와 같은 목적어 it은 빼야 해요. (c) 옳음: so ~ that절에서는 목적어 it이 필요. (d) 옳음: 형용사+enough to. (e) 틀림: enough는 형용사 뒤 → old enough. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• It was careless (A) ___ you to leave the door open.
• It is hard (B) ___ me to wake up early.
items.exp: careless처럼 사람의 성격·태도를 나타내는 형용사 뒤 의미상 주어는 of, hard 같은 일반 형용사 뒤는 for예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The box is too heavy (A) ___.
• I need a spoon (B) ___.
choices: to lift it – to eat with
items.exp: too ~ to 구문에서 주어 the box와 같은 목적어는 쓰지 않아 to lift, 숟가락'으로' 먹으므로 to eat with예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I went to the library [to borrow] some books.
choices: She was happy [to see] her old friend.
He must be rich [to buy] such a car.
He grew up [to be] a famous writer.
I saved money [to buy] a new bike.
items.exp: <보기>의 to borrow는 '~하기 위해'(목적)를 나타내는 부사적 용법이에요. to buy a new bike가 같고, 나머지는 감정의 원인, 판단의 근거, 결과, 형용사적 용법이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I need a friend [to talk with].
choices: There are many places [to visit] in Seoul.
I want [to visit] Jeju this summer.
He was surprised [to hear] the news.
items.exp: <보기>의 to talk with는 앞의 명사 a friend를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요. places를 꾸미는 to visit이 같고, 나머지는 명사적(주어·목적어), 부사적(목적·감정의 원인) 용법이에요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He was ___ any more.
items.exp: so ~ that ... can't는 too ~ to부정사로 바꿀 수 있어요. 주어가 같으므로 의미상 주어는 쓰지 않아요.
items.ctx: He was so tired that he couldn't walk any more.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: She is ___ the top shelf.
items.exp: so ~ that ... can은 형용사+enough to부정사로 바꿔요. enough는 형용사 뒤에 와요.
items.ctx: She is so tall that she can reach the top shelf.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It was very kind [for] you to show me the way. → ___
items.exp: kind처럼 사람의 성격을 나타내는 형용사 뒤 의미상 주어는 of+목적격이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: I didn't know ___ first.
items.exp: '무엇을 ~해야 할지'는 의문사+to부정사 what to do예요.
items.ctx: 나는 무엇을 먼저 해야 할지 몰랐다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He woke up ___ in the hospital.
items.exp: '(깨어 보니) 결국 ~하게 되었다'는 결과의 only to부정사이고, 주어 자신이므로 재귀대명사 himself예요.
items.ctx: 그는 잠에서 깨어 보니 자신이 병원에 있다는 것을 알게 되었다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: She had ___.
items.exp: no one을 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이고, rely on(~에 의지하다)의 전치사 on을 남겨야 해요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 의지할 사람이 아무도 없었다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She avoided looking at me during the meeting.
Making new friends at a new school are not easy.
I'm looking forward to visiting your town.
He is proud of having won the race last year.
Would you mind my sitting here?
items.exp: 동명사구 주어(Making new friends ~)는 단수 취급이라 are → is예요. friends, school에 속지 마세요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He suggested to go to the beach.
I'm considering to change my plan.
She objected to be treated like a child.
When it comes to cook, my dad is the best.
She is used to getting up early in the morning.
items.exp: be used to+동명사(~에 익숙하다)는 옳아요. suggest·consider는 동명사 목적어(going, changing), object to와 when it comes to의 to는 전치사라 being treated, cooking이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: She remembered meeting him at the concert.
He insisted on my paying for dinner.
My brother finally gave up to play computer games.
It's no use worrying about the past.
There is no knowing what will happen next.
items.exp: give up은 동명사를 목적어로 취해요. to play → playing. insist on my paying(의미상 주어 my)과 관용 표현들은 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: This bridge is worth to see at night.
She spent all day to clean her room.
He had difficulty to find the house.
I can't help feeling sorry for the lost puppy.
The noise kept me from fall asleep.
items.exp: cannot help -ing(~하지 않을 수 없다)는 옳아요. be worth seeing, spend 시간 cleaning, have difficulty finding, keep A from falling으로 고쳐요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He is ashamed of not having studied harder.
(b) I don't like being laughed at.
(c) She is afraid of making mistakes.
(d) Do you mind if I opening the window?
(e) Thank you for invite me.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동명사의 부정 not having p.p. (b) 옳음: 수동동명사 being p.p.+전치사 at. (c) 옳음: 전치사 of+동명사. (d) 틀림: if절에는 동사 → if I open (또는 my opening). (e) 틀림: 전치사 뒤엔 동명사 → inviting. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He finished doing his homework.
(b) I enjoy to listen to music.
(c) On arriving at the airport, she called her mom.
(d) I feel like eating something sweet.
(e) She practices playing the piano every day.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: finish+동명사. (b) 틀림: enjoy+동명사 → listening. (c) 옳음: on -ing = ~하자마자. (d) 옳음: feel like -ing = ~하고 싶다. (e) 옳음: practice+동명사. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Her parents worried about her coming home late.
(b) He is busy preparing for the trip.
(c) We look forward to see you soon.
(d) Keeping a diary helps you remember things.
(e) He apologized for having been rude.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 의미상 주어 her+동명사. (b) 옳음: be busy -ing. (c) 틀림: look forward to의 to는 전치사 → seeing. (d) 옳음: 동명사 주어는 단수 helps. (e) 옳음: 앞선 일은 완료동명사. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I remember locking the door, so don't worry.
(b) Don't forget calling your grandma tomorrow.
(c) She stopped eating sweets for her health.
(d) I regret to tell you that you failed the test.
(e) He mentioned having seen her before.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: remember -ing = (과거에) ~한 것을 기억하다. (b) 틀림: 앞으로 할 일은 forget to → to call. (c) 옳음: stop -ing = ~하는 것을 멈추다. (d) 옳음: regret to = ~하게 되어 유감이다. (e) 옳음: mention+완료동명사. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He was punished for being late again.
(b) She is sure of her son's passing the test.
(c) He denied to have taken the money.
(d) The baby kept crying all night.
(e) I'm not used to drive on the left.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 전치사 for+동명사. (b) 옳음: 소유격 의미상 주어+동명사. (c) 틀림: deny는 동명사 목적어 → having taken. (d) 옳음: keep -ing. (e) 틀림: be used to의 to는 전치사 → driving. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She left the room without saying a word.
(b) He is good at to fix things.
(c) Instead of taking the bus, we walked.
(d) I'm thinking about join the club.
(e) What do you say to going for a swim?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: without -ing. (b) 틀림: 전치사 at 뒤엔 동명사 → fixing. (c) 옳음: instead of -ing. (d) 틀림: 전치사 about 뒤엔 동명사 → joining. (e) 옳음: What do you say to -ing? = ~하는 게 어때?. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• He admitted (A) ___ the cookies yesterday.
• I hate (B) ___ to wait for a long time.
items.exp: admit는 동명사를 목적어로 취하고 먹은 일이 앞서므로 having eaten, 내가 '기다리게 되는' 것이라 수동동명사 being made예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The old palace is worth (A) ___.
• She couldn't help (B) ___ when she heard the sad story.
items.exp: be worth -ing(~할 가치가 있다)는 능동형 동명사로 수동의 뜻을 나타내요. cannot help -ing(~하지 않을 수 없다)도 동명사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> My hobby is [collecting] stamps.
choices: The girl [singing] on the stage is my sister.
He is [reading] a book in his room.
Look at the [crying] baby over there.
The man [wearing] a cap is my uncle.
I bought a new [sleeping] bag for the trip.
items.exp: <보기>의 collecting은 보어로 쓰인 동명사예요. sleeping bag은 '잠자기 위한 가방'(용도)이라 동명사이고, 나머지는 진행 중인 동작을 나타내는 현재분사예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: The boy [running] toward us is my brother.
items.exp: The boy를 꾸미는 running은 현재분사예요. 나머지는 보어, 전치사의 목적어, 주어, 동사의 목적어로 쓰인 동명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: She is ashamed of ___ a lie.
items.exp: 전치사 of 뒤 동명사, 거짓말한 주체(아들)는 동명사 앞에 의미상 주어로 쓰고, 부끄러워하는 것보다 앞선 일이라 완료동명사 having told예요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 아들이 거짓말을 했던 것을 부끄러워한다.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: I'm sure of ___ the exam.
items.exp: that절의 주어 he를 동명사의 의미상 주어(소유격 his)로 바꾸고 동사는 동명사 passing으로 써요.
items.ctx: I'm sure that he will pass the exam.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My grandfather is used to [walk] for an hour every morning. → ___
items.exp: be used to(~에 익숙하다)의 to는 전치사라 동명사 walking을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He was disappointed at ___ for the game.
items.exp: 전치사 at 뒤 동명사, '선발되지 않은' 것이므로 동명사의 부정(not)과 수동형(being p.p.)을 함께 써요.
items.ctx: 그는 그 경기에 선발되지 않은 것에 실망했다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: ___ the bus, she fell asleep.
items.exp: '~하자마자'는 On+동명사이고, '버스에 타다'는 get on이에요.
items.ctx: 버스에 타자마자 그녀는 잠이 들었다.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: He doesn't remember ___ the book last week.
items.exp: 과거에 한 일을 기억하는 것은 remember+동명사예요. remember to borrow는 '빌릴 것을 기억하다'라는 뜻이 돼요.
items.ctx: 그는 지난주에 그 책을 빌린 것을 기억하지 못한다.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The man sitting next to me on the bus kept checking his phone.
Most of the furniture left in the old house was covered with dust.
I found the test results quite disappointing.
She had her old bicycle repaired before the trip.
The number of people waiting in line to enter the museum were surprising.
items.exp: 주어가 The number(~의 수)이므로 단수 동사 was가 와야 해요. waiting은 people을 뒤에서 꾸미는 현재분사로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The students were so exciting about the field trip that they couldn't sleep.
We heard the alarm ringing for a few minutes.
The leaves covered with snow looked beautiful in the morning light.
Please leave the door unlocked for the delivery person.
He got his wisdom tooth pulled out last week.
items.exp: 학생들은 '신이 난' 감정을 느끼는 쪽이므로 excited가 맞아요. get+목적어+과거분사(pulled), leave+목적어+과거분사(unlocked)는 모두 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: There are many students wanted to join the science club this year.
The lecture was so bored that half of the students fell asleep.
She kept me waited for almost an hour in the rain.
The bridge building in 1890 is still used by many people today.
The problem discussed at yesterday's meeting has not been solved yet.
items.exp: problem은 '논의된' 것이라 discussed가 옳아요. 나머지는 wanting(원하는), boring(지루하게 하는), waiting(기다리는), built(지어진)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: I heard my name calling from behind, but no one was there.
The broken window was replaced by a new one.
There is a girl named Sora in my class.
I had my hair cut short for the summer.
The news was so shocking that nobody said a word.
items.exp: 이름은 '불리는' 대상이므로 지각동사 hear의 목적격보어로 과거분사 called가 와야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The children playing in the park look happy.
(b) I'm satisfying with my new smartphone.
(c) He left the water running all night.
(d) A lot of the money raised at the event were given to the hospital.
(e) The houses damaged by the storm are being repaired now.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: playing이 children을 뒤에서 수식하고 주어가 복수라 look이 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 내가 '만족한' 것이므로 satisfied예요. (c) 옳음: 물이 '흐르는' 능동 상태라 running이 맞아요. (d) 틀림: a lot of 뒤 money가 셀 수 없는 명사라 was예요. (e) 옳음: 집은 '손상된' 것이라 damaged, 복수 주어라 are예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I watched the sun setting behind the mountains.
(b) The jacket hanging on the wall belong to my brother.
(c) She looked surprised at the news.
(d) I want this letter sending by tomorrow.
(e) The boring movie made us feel sleepy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 해가 '지는' 능동이라 setting이 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 주어가 The jacket(단수)이라 belongs예요. (c) 옳음: 그녀가 '놀란' 것이라 surprised예요. (d) 틀림: 편지는 '보내지는' 대상이라 want+목적어+sent예요. (e) 옳음: 영화가 '지루하게 하는' 것이라 boring이 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The man interviewed on TV last night is my uncle.
(b) Do you know the girl talking to Mr. Han?
(c) We found the old castle deserted.
(d) Keep your eyes closing while I count to ten.
(e) The rising price of food is worrying many families.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 남자는 '인터뷰를 받은' 것이라 interviewed예요. (b) 옳음: 소녀가 '말하고 있는' 능동이라 talking이에요. (c) 옳음: 성이 '버려진' 상태라 목적격보어 deserted가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 눈은 '감겨진' 상태여야 하므로 closed예요. (e) 옳음: rising은 '오르는' 현재분사, is worrying은 진행형으로 옳아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I could hear the rain falling on the roof.
(b) He seemed disappointing with his test score.
(c) The money stolen from the bank has never been found.
(d) The girl wearing glasses are my cousin.
(e) Each of the photos taken during the trip has a story.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 비가 '떨어지는' 능동이라 falling이에요. (b) 틀림: 그가 '실망한' 것이라 disappointed예요. (c) 옳음: 돈은 '도난당한' 것이라 stolen, 단수라 has예요. (d) 틀림: 주어가 The girl이라 is예요. (e) 옳음: photos는 '찍힌' 것이라 taken, Each가 주어라 has예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The fallen leaves made the road slippery.
(b) I got my computer fixing by a friend.
(c) Look at the smoke coming out of the chimney.
(d) Most of the guests invited to the party was late.
(e) The museum has a lot of paintings drawing by children.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: fallen은 '떨어진'(완료)의 과거분사로 옳아요. (b) 틀림: 컴퓨터는 '고쳐지는' 대상이라 get+목적어+fixed예요. (c) 옳음: 연기가 '나오는' 능동이라 coming이에요. (d) 틀림: Most of 뒤 guests가 복수라 were예요. (e) 틀림: 그림은 '그려진' 것이라 drawn이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The story was so moving that I cried.
(b) There was nobody left in the classroom.
(c) I saw him entered the building.
(d) The sleeping bag was too small for my father.
(e) Please keep me informing of any changes.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 이야기가 '감동시키는' 것이라 moving이에요. (b) 옳음: nobody를 '남겨진' 의미의 left가 수식해서 옳아요. (c) 틀림: 그가 '들어가는' 능동이라 enter나 entering이에요. (d) 옳음: sleeping bag의 sleeping은 용도를 나타내는 동명사로 옳아요. (e) 틀림: 내가 '알게 되는' 대상이라 informed예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The view from the top was (A) (amazed / amazing), and all the hikers looked (B) (satisfying / satisfied).
Keep the medicine (C) (storing / stored) in a cool place.
items.exp: (A) 경치가 '놀라움을 주는' 것이라 amazing, (B) 등산객들이 '만족한' 것이라 satisfied, (C) 약은 '보관되는' 대상이라 stored예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The boy (A) (standing / stood) at the gate (B) (is / are) waiting for his parents.
The letters (C) (written / writing) by soldiers during the war were shown at the museum.
items.exp: (A) 이미 동사 is waiting이 있으므로 boy를 꾸미는 현재분사 standing, (B) 주어 The boy가 단수라 is, (C) 편지는 '쓰인' 것이라 written이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> Look at the [sleeping] baby on the bed.
choices: She needs a new [sleeping] bag for the camping trip.
I bought a pair of [running] shoes.
The [barking] dog woke up the whole neighborhood.
We waited in the [waiting] room for an hour.
There is a [smoking] area outside the building.
items.exp: <보기>의 sleeping은 '자고 있는'이라는 동작·상태의 현재분사예요. barking(짖는)도 현재분사이고, 나머지는 '~용'이라는 용도를 나타내는 동명사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> My hobby is [collecting] old coins.
choices: [Swimming] in the river can be dangerous.
My dream is [traveling] to every continent.
The man is [fixing] the roof right now.
items.exp: <보기>의 collecting은 보어로 쓰인 동명사예요. is fixing은 진행형을 만드는 현재분사이고, 나머지는 주어·목적어·보어로 쓰인 동명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어제 공원에서 발견된 지갑은 경찰서로 보내졌다.
items.s: The wallet ___ to the police station.
a: found in the park yesterday was sent
found yesterday in the park was sent
found at the park yesterday was sent
found yesterday at the park was sent
items.exp: 지갑은 '발견된' 것이라 과거분사 found가 뒤에서 수식하고, 본동사는 '보내진' 과거 수동태 was sent예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 결과에 실망한 선수들은 한마디도 하지 않았다.
items.s: The players ___ didn't say a word.
items.exp: 선수들이 '실망한' 감정을 느끼므로 과거분사 disappointed가 전치사구와 함께 뒤에서 수식해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The man [interviewing] by the reporter seemed nervous. → ___
items.exp: 남자는 기자에 의해 '인터뷰를 받은' 대상이므로 과거분사 interviewed예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The information [providing] on this website is not always correct. → ___
items.exp: 정보는 '제공되는' 대상이므로 과거분사 provided가 뒤에서 수식해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 상자 안에 남겨진 사진들은 할머니에 의해 발견되었다.
items.s: The photos ___ by my grandmother.
a: left in the box were found
left inside the box were found
items.exp: 사진은 '남겨진' 것이라 left가 수식하고, 복수 주어의 과거 수동태라 were found예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 복도에서 내 이름이 불리는 소리를 두 번 들었다.
items.s: I ___ twice in the hallway.
items.exp: 이름은 '불리는' 대상이므로 지각동사 hear+목적어+과거분사 called예요. 과거 일이라 heard를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Having finished her homework, she went out to play badminton.
Not knowing the way, we asked a police officer for help.
Written in simple English, the book is popular among beginners.
It being a holiday, most of the shops were closed.
Leaving the house in a hurry, his phone was left on the table.
items.exp: 분사구문의 의미상 주어는 주절의 주어와 같아야 해요. 서두른 것은 '그'인데 주절 주어가 his phone이라 틀려요(he left his phone ~으로 고쳐야 해요).

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Having been built 200 years ago, the bridge needs repairs.
Seeing from a distance, the rock looks like a lion's face.
There being no bus, so we had to walk home.
She listened to music with her eyes closing.
After finished the test, the students left the classroom.
items.exp: 다리는 과거에 '지어진' 것이라 완료 수동 분사구문 Having been built가 옳아요. 나머지는 Seen, so 삭제, closed, After finishing으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Weather permitting, the festival will be held outdoors.
Turning left at the corner, you will find the bakery.
Strictly speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
Having lived in Canada for years, he speaks English well.
Exhausting after the long hike, we went to bed early.
items.exp: 우리가 '지친' 상태이므로 수동의 Exhausted가 와야 해요. Weather permitting은 의미상 주어가 다른 독립분사구문으로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: While waited for the bus, I read a few pages of my book.
When asked about the accident, he refused to answer.
Though living near the sea, she cannot swim.
The sun having set, we started a campfire.
He walked into the room, followed by his dog.
items.exp: 내가 버스를 '기다리는' 능동이므로 접속사를 남긴 분사구문은 While waiting이 되어야 해요. When asked는 그가 '질문을 받은' 수동이라 옳아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Not wanting to be late, she took a taxi.
(b) Having seen the movie before, I knew the ending.
(c) Covering with snow, the mountain looked white.
(d) It was cold, we stayed inside all day.
(e) He sat on the bench with his legs crossed.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부정어 not이 분사 앞에 와서 옳아요. (b) 옳음: 영화를 본 것이 주절보다 앞선 일이라 완료형이 맞아요. (c) 틀림: 산은 눈으로 '덮인' 것이라 Covered예요. (d) 틀림: 접속사 없이 두 절을 이을 수 없어요. It being cold로 바꿔야 해요. (e) 옳음: 다리가 '꼬인' 상태라 with+목적어+crossed가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Having been invited to the party, she bought a new dress.
(b) Generally speaking, children learn languages faster than adults.
(c) Being no money left, I couldn't buy lunch.
(d) Talking on the phone, the soup boiled over.
(e) Not having finished the report, he couldn't leave the office.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 그녀가 먼저 '초대받은' 것이라 완료 수동형이 맞아요. (b) 옳음: Generally speaking은 비인칭 독립분사구문이에요. (c) 틀림: 주절 주어 I와 다른 there 구문이므로 There being이에요. (d) 틀림: 통화한 것은 사람인데 주절 주어가 the soup이라 틀려요. (e) 옳음: not이 완료 분사 앞에 와서 옳아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Shocked by the news, she couldn't say anything.
(b) With night coming on, the air got colder.
(c) Having lost his wallet, he had to borrow some money.
(d) Considering her age, she looks very young.
(e) Seen the police, the thief ran away.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 그녀가 '충격받은' 것이라 Shocked예요. (b) 옳음: 밤이 '다가오는' 능동이라 with+목적어+coming이에요. (c) 옳음: 지갑을 잃은 것이 먼저라 완료형이 맞아요. (d) 옳음: Considering(~을 고려하면)은 비인칭 독립분사구문이에요. (e) 틀림: 도둑이 경찰을 '본' 능동이라 Seeing이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Being over the game, the fans left the stadium.
(b) Disappointing with the result, he went home quietly.
(c) Not knowing what to do, I called my mom.
(d) The dog ran to me with its tail wagged.
(e) Having been told the truth by his friend, he felt better.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 주절과 주어가 다르므로 The game being over로 써야 해요. (b) 틀림: 그가 '실망한' 것이라 Disappointed예요. (c) 옳음: not이 분사 앞에 있어 옳아요. (d) 틀림: 꼬리가 '흔들리는' 능동 동작이라 wagging이에요. (e) 옳음: 그가 먼저 진실을 '들은' 것이라 완료 수동형이 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Speaking of music, have you heard the new song?
(b) Finished the test early, she checked her answers again.
(c) Built in 1900, the hotel still looks modern.
(d) Walking down the street, a strange sound was heard.
(e) He stood still, his eyes fixing on the stage.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Speaking of는 관용적 독립분사구문이에요. (b) 틀림: 그녀가 시험을 '끝낸' 능동이라 Having finished(또는 Finishing)예요. (c) 옳음: 호텔은 '지어진' 것이라 Built예요. (d) 틀림: 걸은 것은 사람인데 주절 주어가 a strange sound라 틀려요. (e) 틀림: 눈이 무대에 '고정된' 상태라 fixed예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If compared with his brother, he is much quieter.
(b) Being sick, Tom stayed home from school.
(c) Written in a hurry, the letter had many mistakes.
(d) Leaving alone, the baby started to cry.
(e) Arrived at the station, I called my friend.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 그가 '비교되는' 것이라 접속사를 남긴 If compared가 맞아요. (b) 옳음: 이유를 나타내는 분사구문으로 옳아요. (c) 옳음: 편지는 '쓰인' 것이라 Written이에요. (d) 틀림: 아기가 '홀로 남겨진' 것이라 Left예요. (e) 틀림: 내가 '도착한' 능동이라 Arriving(또는 Having arrived)이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) (Seeing / Seen) from the sky, the island looks like a heart.
(B) (Having / Being) finished dinner, we went for a walk.
(C) (It / There) being no one at home, I left a note.
items.exp: (A) 섬은 '보여지는' 것이라 Seen, (B) 저녁을 '끝낸' 능동 완료라 Having finished, (C) there is 구문의 분사구문이라 There being이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) (Compared / Comparing) with other cities, Seoul has many mountains.
(B) The old man walked slowly, (followed / following) by his grandson.
(C) She stood at the window with the rain (pouring / poured) outside.
items.exp: (A) 서울이 '비교되는' 것이라 Compared, (B) 노인이 손자에게 '뒤따름을 받는' 수동이라 followed, (C) 비가 '쏟아지는' 능동이라 pouring이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 분사구문과 의미가 같은 것은?
<보기> [Having no money], he couldn't buy the ticket.
choices: [Turning to the left], you'll see the post office.
[Walking along the beach], I found a shell.
[Feeling sick], she left the party early.
[Living next door], I rarely see her.
items.exp: <보기>는 '돈이 없어서'라는 이유예요. Feeling sick도 '아파서'라는 이유이고, 나머지는 조건, 때, 양보(옆집에 살지만), 동시동작이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 분사구문과 의미가 같은 것은?
<보기> [Taking this bus], you will get there in 20 minutes.
choices: [Opening the box], she found a ring.
[Being tired], I went to bed early.
[Hearing the news], she burst into tears.
[Working harder], you will pass the test easily.
[Sitting on the sofa], he watched TV.
items.exp: <보기>는 '이 버스를 타면'이라는 조건이에요. Working harder도 '더 열심히 하면'의 조건이고, 나머지는 때, 이유, 때, 동시동작이에요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 분사구문을 이용해 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As I didn't know his phone number, I couldn't call him.
items.s: ___ his phone number, I couldn't call him.
items.exp: 부정 분사구문은 not을 분사 앞에 두어 Not knowing으로 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 분사구문을 이용해 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Because the house had been painted the day before, it smelled of paint.
items.s: ___ the day before, the house smelled of paint.
items.exp: 칠해진 일이 주절보다 앞서고 집은 '칠해진' 대상이므로 완료 수동 분사구문 Having been painted예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 분사구문을 이용해 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Since it was rainy, the game was canceled.
items.s: ___ rainy, the game was canceled.
items.exp: 부사절 주어 it이 주절 주어 the game과 다르므로 남겨 둔 독립분사구문 It being이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 TV를 켜 둔 채로 잠이 들었다.
items.s: He fell asleep ___.
items.exp: TV가 '켜진' 상태이므로 with+목적어+과거분사 turned on이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [Surrounding] by tall buildings, the park feels quiet and peaceful. → ___
items.exp: 공원은 건물들에 '둘러싸인' 것이라 과거분사 Surrounded로 시작해야 해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 질문을 받았을 때, 그녀는 아무 대답도 하지 않았다.
items.s: ___, she gave no answer.
items.exp: 그녀가 질문을 '받은' 수동이므로 When (she was) asked에서 주어와 be동사를 생략한 When asked the question이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I've never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
The elderly in this town needs more support from the government.
She was the only person awake at that time.
Is there anything wrong with your phone?
The soup tastes a little salty.
items.exp: 'the+형용사'는 '~한 사람들'이라는 복수 보통명사라 need가 와야 해요. awake는 서술적 형용사로 명사 뒤에서 수식할 수 있어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She bought a wooden small round table.
The alive fish were put back into the river.
We need someone strongly to carry these boxes.
It was so a boring lecture that I fell asleep.
He is too proud a man to ask for help.
items.exp: too/so+형용사+a+명사 어순이라 too proud a man이 옳아요. 나머지는 a small round wooden table, live(living) fish, someone strong, so boring a lecture로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The two brothers look alike, but their personalities are different.
All the old wooden toys were donated to the children's hospital.
Please keep your room clean and tidy.
The people present at the meeting agreed with the plan.
This book is worth to read more than once.
items.exp: worth 뒤에는 동명사가 와서 worth reading이 되어야 해요. 명사 뒤의 present는 '참석한'이라는 뜻으로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Thank you for being so considerable of my feelings.
The rescue team found the missing climber alive.
He gave me a sensible piece of advice.
We spent a considerable amount of money on the trip.
Riding a bike to work is economical.
items.exp: '남을 배려하는'은 considerate예요. considerable은 '상당한'이라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The rich is not always happier than the poor.
How a lovely day it is!
The first three chapters of the book are very difficult.
She felt sadly when she heard the story.
I want to buy a new something for my mom.
items.exp: 서수+기수 어순이라 The first three가 옳아요. 나머지는 are, What a lovely day(또는 How lovely a day), sad, something new로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The injured were carried to the nearest hospital.
(b) She has a beautiful long black hair.
(c) I'm looking for someone reliable to work with.
(d) The boys were afraid of the big dog.
(e) My mom bought an Italian expensive leather bag.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the injured는 '부상자들'로 복수라 were예요. (b) 틀림: 머리카락 전체를 뜻하는 hair는 셀 수 없어 a를 빼야 해요. (c) 옳음: -one으로 끝나는 대명사는 형용사가 뒤에서 수식해요. (d) 옳음: afraid는 서술적 용법으로 옳게 쓰였어요. (e) 틀림: 어순은 판단(expensive)-출처(Italian)-재료(leather)라 an expensive Italian leather bag이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The concert was attended by both the old and the young.
(b) He is the main reason why we won.
(c) The guests present was surprised by the news.
(d) She keeps her answers short and clear.
(e) It is such an exciting game that nobody wants to leave.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the old, the young은 '노인들, 젊은이들'로 옳아요. (b) 옳음: main은 한정적 용법으로만 쓰이는데 명사 앞에 있어 옳아요. (c) 틀림: 주어 The guests가 복수라 were예요. (d) 옳음: keep+목적어+형용사 보어라 옳아요. (e) 옳음: such+a(n)+형용사+명사 어순이라 옳아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Do you know anyone kind enough to help us?
(b) She looked lovely in her new dress.
(c) The ashamed boy said nothing.
(d) I have never been to so quiet a place.
(e) There were five hundred people present.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: anyone을 형용사구 kind enough가 뒤에서 수식해요. (b) 옳음: lovely는 -ly로 끝나지만 형용사라 보어로 옳아요. (c) 틀림: ashamed는 서술적 용법으로만 써서 명사 앞에 올 수 없어요. (d) 옳음: so+형용사+a+명사 어순이라 옳아요. (e) 옳음: 숫자 앞 hundred는 단수형, present는 '참석한'으로 뒤에서 수식해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The sick need special care during the winter.
(b) There was an alone man standing at the bus stop.
(c) They live in a small white wooden house.
(d) I want to eat sweet something.
(e) The baby is alive and well.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the sick은 '아픈 사람들'로 복수라 need예요. (b) 틀림: alone은 서술적 용법만 있어서 명사 앞에는 lone을 써요. (c) 옳음: 크기-색-재료 어순이라 옳아요. (d) 틀림: something은 형용사가 뒤에서 수식해 something sweet이에요. (e) 옳음: alive는 보어로 쓰여 옳아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Such a strange thing has never happened here.
(b) The unemployed is looking for jobs.
(c) A basket full of apples was on the table.
(d) She was not aware the danger.
(e) The audience found the show amazing.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: such+a+형용사+명사 어순이라 옳아요. (b) 틀림: the unemployed는 '실업자들'로 복수라 are예요. (c) 옳음: 형용사구 full of apples가 뒤에서 수식하고 주어 A basket이 단수라 was예요. (d) 틀림: aware는 of와 함께 써서 aware of the danger예요. (e) 옳음: find+목적어+형용사 보어라 옳아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He is the elder of the two sons.
(b) My elder brother is three years older than me.
(c) My brother is elder than me.
(d) The present situation is very serious.
(e) They live in a big brick old house.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the elder of the two는 '둘 중 손위인 사람'이라는 표현으로 옳아요. (b) 옳음: 명사 앞 elder, than 비교에는 older를 써서 옳아요. (c) 틀림: elder는 than과 함께 서술적으로 쓰지 않아서 older예요. (d) 옳음: 명사 앞 present는 '현재의'라는 뜻으로 옳아요. (e) 틀림: 크기-나이-재료 어순이라 a big old brick house예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The (sleeping / asleep) cat on the sofa looks so peaceful.
(B) Students should be (aware / awake) of the school rules.
(C) She is always (respectful / respectable) to older people.
items.exp: (A) asleep은 명사 앞에 못 와서 sleeping, (B) '~을 알고 있는'은 aware of, (C) '공손한'은 respectful이에요(respectable은 '존경할 만한').

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) There's (nothing new / new nothing) in today's paper.
(B) The museum has (a lovely old Chinese / an old lovely Chinese) vase.
(C) The young (has / have) to respect the old.
choices: new nothing – a lovely old Chinese – have
nothing new – an old lovely Chinese – have
nothing new – a lovely old Chinese – have
nothing new – a lovely old Chinese – has
new nothing – an old lovely Chinese – has
items.exp: (A) -thing은 형용사가 뒤에서 수식, (B) 판단-나이-출처 어순, (C) the young은 복수라 have예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The (living / alive) creatures in the deep sea are hard to study.
(B) This movie is (worth / worthy) watching.
(C) The poor (was / were) given food and blankets.
items.exp: (A) alive는 명사 앞에 못 와서 living, (B) 동명사를 바로 받는 것은 worth, (C) the poor는 복수라 were예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 너무 친절한 사람이어서 그 부탁을 거절할 수 없었다.
items.s: She was ___ to refuse the request.
items.exp: too+형용사+a+명사 어순이라 too kind a person이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 사고에서 부상당한 사람들은 근처 병원으로 옮겨졌다.
items.s: In the accident, ___ to a nearby hospital.
items.exp: '부상자들'은 the injured이고 복수 취급하며, '옮겨진' 수동이라 were taken이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리는 오래된 둥근 이탈리아산 탁자를 샀다.
items.hint: (old, round, Italian, table) 배열, 관사 포함 5단어
items.s: We bought ___.
items.exp: 형용사 어순은 나이(old)-모양(round)-출처(Italian)이고, old가 모음으로 시작해 an을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The museum is [worth to visit] at least once. → ___
items.exp: worth는 동명사를 목적어로 받아 worth visiting이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [The asleep] children were carried to their beds. → ___
items.exp: asleep은 서술적 용법만 있어 명사 앞에서는 sleeping을 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He is such an honest boy that everybody trusts him.
items.s: He is ___ boy that everybody trusts him.
items.exp: such+a+형용사+명사는 so+형용사+a+명사로 바꿀 수 있어 so honest a예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Two-thirds of the cake was eaten by the kids.
My uncle has a ten-year-old car.
Thousands of people gathered in the square.
There is little water in the tank, so we must save it.
A number of students in my school is learning Chinese.
items.exp: a number of+복수명사는 '많은 ~'이라는 뜻으로 복수 동사 are를 써야 해요. 분수 of 뒤 the cake가 단수라 was는 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Many a student has failed to answer this question.
The number of cars on the road have increased greatly.
Every four year, the Olympic Games are held.
Three-fourth of the students agreed with the plan.
items.exp: many a+단수명사는 단수 동사를 받아 has가 옳아요. 나머지는 has, three-year-old, Every four years, Three-fourths로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Only a few of my friends came to the party.
He was born in the early 2000s.
Most of the money has been spent.
Every third day, she visits her grandmother.
Lots of the furniture in this room were made by my grandfather.
items.exp: lots of 뒤의 명사에 수를 맞추는데 furniture는 셀 수 없는 명사라 was가 와야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: There were quite a little people at the concert.
Not a few students were absent because of the flu.
We have plenty of time, so don't hurry.
Half of the apples in the box were rotten.
Millions of dollars were donated to the hospital.
items.exp: people은 셀 수 있는 복수명사라 '꽤 많은'은 quite a few로 써야 해요. not a few는 '적지 않은(많은)'으로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Five millions people live in this city.
Ten percent of the students was absent today.
The amount of trash produced each day is increasing.
I don't have many money left this month.
A large number of water is used in farming.
items.exp: the amount of가 주어라 단수 is가 옳아요. 나머지는 million, were, much, amount로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Two hundred people were invited to the wedding.
(b) A great number of birds is flying south.
(c) She has little interest in politics.
(d) I visit my grandparents every other week.
(e) He wrote dozens of letters to her.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 숫자 뒤 hundred는 단수형이라 옳아요. (b) 틀림: a great number of+복수명사는 복수 동사 are예요. (c) 옳음: interest는 셀 수 없는 명사라 little이 맞아요. (d) 옳음: every other week는 '격주로'라는 뜻으로 옳아요. (e) 옳음: dozens of는 '수십의'라는 뜻으로 옳아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) My father was born in 1975s.
(b) Each of the boys has a bike.
(c) A lot of information is available online.
(d) The man is in his late forties.
(e) Only a few water was left in the bottle.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 특정 연도는 1975로 쓰고 -s를 붙이지 않아요. (b) 옳음: each가 주어라 단수 has예요. (c) 옳음: information은 셀 수 없어 is가 맞아요. (d) 옳음: '40대 후반'은 in one's late forties예요. (e) 틀림: water는 셀 수 없어 a little이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Few of the guests stayed until midnight.
(b) Much of the students were tired.
(c) Many a man have tried to climb that mountain.
(d) Two-thirds of the students live near the school.
(e) I have a great deal of homework to do.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: guests는 셀 수 있어 few가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: students는 셀 수 있어 Many예요. (c) 틀림: many a+단수명사는 단수 동사 has예요. (d) 옳음: 분수 of 뒤 students가 복수라 live예요. (e) 옳음: homework는 셀 수 없어 a great deal of가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) A five-year-old child can understand this.
(b) The number of applicants were smaller than expected.
(c) Hundreds of people lined up for the new phone.
(d) There is a few bread left.
(e) Every students in the class was given a book.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 하이픈으로 연결된 형용사 속 명사는 단수형 year예요. (b) 틀림: the number of는 '~의 수'로 단수 was예요. (c) 옳음: 막연한 수는 hundreds of로 써요. (d) 틀림: bread는 셀 수 없어 a little이에요. (e) 틀림: every 뒤에는 단수명사 student가 와요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) A large amount of money was stolen.
(b) There were not much people in the park.
(c) Twice a week, I go swimming.
(d) I've been to Japan a few times.
(e) One of my friends live in Canada.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 셀 수 없는 money에 amount를 쓰고 단수 was예요. (b) 틀림: people은 셀 수 있어 many예요. (c) 옳음: 빈도 표현 twice a week로 옳아요. (d) 옳음: times는 셀 수 있어 a few가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: 주어가 One이라 lives예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He has visited quite a few countries in Asia.
(b) Half of the money were spent on food.
(c) Three thousand dollars is too much for a bike.
(d) My grandmother is in her eighties.
(e) Many a child enjoys this game.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: quite a few는 '꽤 많은'으로 셀 수 있는 명사와 써요. (b) 틀림: half of 뒤 money가 셀 수 없어 was예요. (c) 옳음: 금액은 하나의 덩어리로 보아 단수 is예요. (d) 옳음: '80대'는 in one's eighties예요. (e) 옳음: many a+단수명사는 단수 동사 enjoys예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Very (few / little) students came to the class.
(B) There's still (little / a little) milk left, so you don't need to buy more.
(C) (Hundred / Hundreds) of birds flew over the lake.
items.exp: (A) students는 셀 수 있어 few, (B) 더 살 필요가 없으니 '조금 있는' a little, (C) 막연한 수 '수백의'는 Hundreds of예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The number of tourists (has / have) doubled since last year.
(B) Three-fifths of the land (is / are) covered with forests.
(C) Most of the cookies (was / were) eaten by my brother.
items.exp: (A) the number of는 단수 has, (B) 분수 of 뒤 the land가 단수라 is, (C) most of 뒤 cookies가 복수라 were예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Every (two hours / two hour), the bus leaves for the airport.
(B) He made (a great deal of / a great many) mistakes on the test.
(C) There isn't (many / much) sugar in the jar.
choices: two hour – a great many – much
two hours – a great deal of – much
two hours – a great many – many
two hours – a great many – much
two hour – a great deal of – many
items.exp: (A) every+기수+복수명사라 two hours, (B) 셀 수 있는 mistakes에는 a great many, (C) 셀 수 없는 sugar에는 much예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 반 학생들의 3분의 2가 그 계획에 찬성했다.
items.s: ___ with the plan.
a: Two-thirds of the students in the class agreed
Two thirds of the students in the class agreed
Two-thirds of the students of the class agreed
Two thirds of the students of the class agreed
items.exp: 분수는 분자(기수)-분모(서수)이고 분자가 2 이상이라 분모에 -s를 붙여 two-thirds예요. 과거 일이라 agreed예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 많은 학생들이 그 질문에 답하지 못했다.
items.s: ___ to answer the question.
items.exp: many a 뒤에는 단수명사 student가 오고, 과거 일이라 failed예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Many students attended the lecture.
items.s: ___ students attended the lecture.
items.exp: not a few는 '적지 않은', 즉 '많은'이라는 뜻으로 many와 같아요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: There are [a little] chairs left in the hall. → ___
items.exp: chairs는 셀 수 있는 복수명사라 a few를 써야 해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 마을을 방문하는 관광객 수가 작년 이후로 두 배가 되었다.
items.s: The number of tourists ___ since last year.
items.exp: tourists를 현재분사 visiting이 뒤에서 수식하고, 주어 the number가 단수이며 since가 있어 현재완료 has doubled예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: This program has been watched by [ten millions] of people around the world. → ___
items.exp: 막연한 큰 수는 '수천만의'처럼 tens of millions of로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The plane was flying high above the clouds.
I have been very busy lately.
She smiled at me friendly when we first met.
The bus arrived ten minutes late.
