items.exp: friendly는 -ly로 끝나지만 형용사라 동사를 꾸밀 수 없어요. in a friendly way로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She is old enough to travel by herself.
He usually is in his office in the morning.
The singer is high respected by young people.
We worked hardly all day to finish the project.
The movie was enough interesting to watch twice.
items.exp: enough는 형용사 뒤에 와서 old enough가 옳아요. 나머지는 is usually, highly, hard, interesting enough로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The mountain village was pretty quiet.
I nearly missed the train this morning.
He sometimes goes jogging after dinner.
The price of vegetables has risen sharp this month.
items.exp: 동사 has risen을 꾸미므로 부사 sharply가 와야 해요. pretty는 '꽤'라는 부사로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: The flowers in the garden smell sweetly in spring.
He looked carefully at the old map.
They arrived safely at the hotel late at night.
items.exp: 감각동사 smell 뒤에는 보어로 형용사 sweet이 와야 해요. look at(~을 보다)은 동작이라 부사 carefully가 옳아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) She has nearly finished her homework.
(b) Kevin is always kind to everyone.
(c) The test was enough easy for me.
(d) He spoke so quiet that I couldn't hear him.
(e) The baby is sleeping peacefully in her room.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: nearly는 '거의'라는 부사로 옳아요. (b) 옳음: 빈도부사는 be동사 뒤에 와요. (c) 틀림: enough는 형용사 뒤에 와서 easy enough예요. (d) 틀림: 동사 spoke를 꾸미므로 quietly예요. (e) 옳음: 부사 peacefully가 동사를 꾸며 옳아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The boy can hardly read.
(b) I have never seen such a big fish.
(c) She drives careful at night.
(d) This book is highly recommended by teachers.
(e) He often is late for work.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: hardly는 '거의 ~않다'로 조동사 뒤에 와요. (b) 옳음: never는 have와 p.p. 사이에 와요. (c) 틀림: 동사를 꾸미므로 carefully예요. (d) 옳음: highly는 '매우'라는 뜻으로 옳아요. (e) 틀림: 빈도부사는 be동사 뒤에 와서 is often late예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'll call you back shortly.
(b) The doctor examined the patient closely.
(c) She looks lovely today.
(d) Please speak a little more slowly.
(e) We hardly ever go out on weekdays.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: shortly는 '곧'이라는 뜻으로 옳아요. (b) 옳음: closely는 '면밀히'라는 뜻으로 옳아요. (c) 옳음: lovely는 형용사라 look의 보어로 옳아요. (d) 옳음: 부사 slowly의 비교급 more slowly로 옳아요. (e) 옳음: hardly ever는 '거의 ~않다'로 일반동사 앞에 와요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d), (e) 5개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She can sing pretty well.
(b) He worked hardly, so he passed the exam.
(c) The plan was carefully made.
(d) The kids played happy in the yard.
(e) Have you seen him lately?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: pretty는 '꽤'라는 부사로 옳아요. (b) 틀림: '열심히'는 hard이고 hardly는 '거의 ~않다'예요. (c) 옳음: 부사 carefully가 과거분사를 꾸며 옳아요. (d) 틀림: 동사 played를 꾸미므로 happily예요. (e) 옳음: lately는 '최근에'로 현재완료와 잘 어울려요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The water is warm enough to swim in.
(b) I rarely go to the movies.
(c) The house was near destroyed by the fire.
(d) He is a high skilled engineer.
(e) She will be never late again.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 형용사+enough 어순이라 옳아요. (b) 옳음: 빈도부사가 일반동사 앞에 와서 옳아요. (c) 틀림: '거의'는 nearly예요. (d) 틀림: 형용사 skilled를 꾸미는 '매우'는 highly예요. (e) 틀림: 빈도부사는 조동사 뒤에 와서 will never be예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The children usually go to bed at nine.
(b) Speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
(c) The task seemed simply at first.
(d) I can't hardly wait for vacation.
(e) The water was deeply enough to dive in.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 빈도부사가 일반동사 앞에 와서 옳아요. (b) 옳음: 부사 clearly가 동사를 꾸며 옳아요. (c) 틀림: seem 뒤 보어는 형용사 simple이에요. (d) 틀림: hardly 자체가 부정이라 can hardly wait이에요. (e) 틀림: be동사의 보어는 형용사 deep이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She has been very busy (late / lately).
(B) The kite flew (high / highly) in the sky.
(C) I can (hardly / hard) believe the news.
items.exp: (A) '최근에'는 lately, (B) 실제로 '높이' 나는 것은 high(highly는 '매우'), (C) '거의 ~않다'는 hardly예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The box is (enough light / light enough) for me to carry.
(B) My father (always is / is always) tired on Mondays.
(C) She (will never / never will) forget that day.
choices: light enough – is always – will never
enough light – is always – will never
light enough – always is – will never
light enough – is always – never will
enough light – always is – never will
items.exp: (A) enough는 형용사 뒤에 와서 light enough, (B) 빈도부사는 be동사 뒤, (C) 빈도부사는 조동사 뒤에 와요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> The train arrived [late] because of the snow.
choices: We had a [late] lunch at a small café.
He often stays up [late] to study.
It's too [late] to change the plan.
items.exp: <보기>의 late는 동사 arrived를 꾸미는 부사예요. stays up late의 late도 부사이고, 나머지는 명사를 꾸미거나 보어로 쓰인 형용사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> He can run very [fast].
choices: Don't drive so [fast] on this road.
Time goes by [fast] when you're having fun.
items.exp: <보기>의 fast는 동사를 꾸미는 부사예요. a fast learner의 fast는 명사를 꾸미는 형용사이고, 나머지는 모두 부사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 너무 피곤해서 거의 눈을 뜨고 있을 수 없었다.
items.s: He was so tired that he ___ open.
items.exp: hardly는 조동사 뒤에 오고, keep+목적어+형용사(open) 구조라 could hardly keep his eyes예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 방은 우리 모두가 들어갈 만큼 충분히 크지 않았다.
items.s: The room ___ to fit in.
a: was not big enough for all of us
items.exp: enough는 형용사 뒤에 오고, to부정사의 의미상 주어는 for all of us로 나타내요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Her story was [high] praised by the readers. → ___
items.exp: 과거분사 praised를 꾸미는 '매우'는 highly예요. high는 '높이'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She [always is] the first to arrive at school. → ___
items.exp: 빈도부사는 be동사 뒤에 와요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 최근에 그를 거의 보지 못했다.
items.exp: lately(최근에)는 현재완료와 함께 쓰고, hardly는 have와 p.p. 사이에 와요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The question was so easy that a child could answer it.
items.s: The question was ___ a child to answer.
items.exp: so ~ that ... can은 형용사+enough+for 의미상 주어+to부정사로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: We have been friends since we were five.
Have you finished your homework yet?
The movie was much too long for children.
Please turn it down a little.
She has lost her umbrella on the way home yesterday.
items.exp: yesterday처럼 분명한 과거 시점은 현재완료와 쓸 수 없어 lost로 고쳐야 해요. much too는 too를 강조하는 옳은 표현이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She hasn't called me yet, but she still plans to come.
The room was too much hot to sleep in.
I don't like spicy food, and my brother doesn't too.
I'm interested in this project, and so does my sister.
I'll pick up you at seven.
items.exp: 부정문의 '아직'은 yet, 긍정문의 '여전히'는 still이라 옳아요. 나머지는 much too hot, either, so is my sister, pick you up으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Have you ever eaten Indian food?
She is by far the fastest runner on our team.
Even my little brother knows the answer.
He has just now arrived at the airport.
items.exp: just now(방금 전)는 과거 시점을 나타내므로 과거형 arrived와 써야 해요. by far는 최상급을 강조하는 표현으로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Tom didn't go to the party, and neither did I.
She was so a kind girl that everyone liked her.
I have never been to Japan, and I have never been to China neither.
The new library is much more bigger than the old one.
When have you finished the project?
items.exp: 부정문에 동의할 때 neither+조동사+주어 어순이라 옳아요. 나머지는 such a kind girl, either, much bigger, When did you finish로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Have you seen my keys anywhere?
He came back home a week ago.
Please put your toys away right now.
The bag is far too heavy for a child.
items.exp: 2010은 시작 시점이므로 for가 아니라 since를 써야 해요. far too는 too를 강조하는 옳은 표현이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I've known her since we were children.
(b) The train has already left when we got there.
(c) Is there anything else you need?
(d) Please wake me up at six.
(e) He doesn't eat meat, and she doesn't either.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: since+과거 시점과 현재완료가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 과거 시점보다 먼저 일어난 일이라 had already left예요. (c) 옳음: else는 anything 뒤에 와요. (d) 옳음: 이어동사의 목적어가 대명사면 동사와 부사 사이에 와요. (e) 옳음: 부정문의 '~도'는 either예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I saw her just now at the bus stop.
(b) She's still waiting for his reply.
(c) My sister is very more patient than I am.
(d) Have you heard from him since?
(e) I tried on it, but it was too small.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: just now는 과거형과 함께 써요. (b) 옳음: still은 '여전히'로 진행형과 옳게 쓰였어요. (c) 틀림: 비교급 강조는 much(far, even 등)예요. (d) 옳음: since가 '그 이후로'라는 부사로 현재완료와 쓰였어요. (e) 틀림: 대명사 목적어는 tried it on 어순이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I've never heard such a sad story.
(b) The weather was too much cold for a picnic.
(c) I lost my key yesterday, and I haven't found it yet.
(d) He works very harder than I do.
(e) My dad gave up smoking ten years ago.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: such a+형용사+명사 어순이 맞아요. (b) 틀림: too를 강조할 때는 much too cold예요. (c) 옳음: 부정문의 yet이 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 비교급 강조는 much harder예요. (e) 옳음: ago는 과거형과 함께 써요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I'll put away it after dinner.
(b) He has gone to Busan last week.
(c) She has never been late for school.
(d) I don't have a pen, and he doesn't have one too.
(e) Even a small mistake can cause big problems.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 대명사 목적어는 put it away 어순이에요. (b) 틀림: last week는 과거 시점이라 went예요. (c) 옳음: never는 have와 p.p. 사이에 와요. (d) 틀림: 부정문의 '~도'는 either예요. (e) 옳음: even이 명사구를 강조해 옳아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) We have been friends since ten years.
(b) She has already eaten lunch.
(c) Who else came to the meeting?
(d) This is by far the best book I've read.
(e) I was too much tired to walk.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 기간 앞에는 for를 써서 for ten years예요. (b) 옳음: 긍정문의 already가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: else는 의문사 뒤에 와요. (d) 옳음: by far가 최상급을 강조해요. (e) 틀림: too 강조는 much too tired예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Have you ever been to Jeju-do?
(b) I didn't go there, and Tom didn't, too.
(c) She left an hour ago.
(d) Has the bus come yet?
(e) He asked me if I had seen her before.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 의문문의 ever가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 부정문의 '~도'는 either예요. (c) 옳음: ago는 과거형과 함께 써요. (d) 옳음: 의문문의 yet은 '벌써, 이제'예요. (e) 옳음: before가 과거완료와 함께 '전에'로 쓰였어요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I haven't finished my report (yet / already).
(B) He moved to Seoul five years (ago / before), and he still lives there.
(C) This music is too loud. Can you turn (off it / it off)?
items.exp: (A) 부정문의 '아직'은 yet, (B) 현재 기준 '~전에'는 ago, (C) 대명사 목적어는 turn it off 어순이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She isn't hungry, and I'm not, (too / either).
(B) This bag is (much / very) heavier than it looks.
(C) The test was (too much / much too) difficult for us.
items.exp: (A) 부정문 동의는 either, (B) 비교급 강조는 much, (C) too를 강조할 때는 much too 어순이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I have (ever / never) seen such a huge whale.
(B) It was (such / so) nice weather that we went outside.
(C) I'm a big fan of soccer, and (so is / so does) my father.
items.exp: (A) 평서문에서 '한 번도 ~ 않다'는 never, (B) 셀 수 없는 weather 앞에는 such nice weather, (C) be동사 문장에 동의하므로 so is예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 책을 이미 두 번 읽어서 다시 읽고 싶지 않다.
items.s: I ___, so I don't want to read it again.
items.exp: 경험·완료를 나타내는 현재완료이고 already는 have와 p.p. 사이에 와요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 그 영화를 좋아하지 않았고, 나도 그랬다.
items.s: He didn't like the movie, and ___.
items.exp: 부정문에 동의할 때 neither+조동사+주어 어순이고 과거라 did를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He moved here in 2018. He still lives here.
items.exp: 과거부터 지금까지 계속되는 일은 현재완료진행형으로, 시작 시점 앞에는 since를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My grandfather [has died] ten years ago. → ___
items.exp: ago는 명확한 과거 시점을 나타내므로 현재완료가 아닌 과거형 died를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I'm not good at singing, and my brother isn't [too]. → ___
items.exp: 부정문에 '~도 역시'를 붙일 때는 either를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그가 도착했을 때, 기차는 이미 떠나 버렸다.
items.s: When he arrived, the train ___.
items.exp: 도착한 과거보다 먼저 일어난 일이라 과거완료이고 already는 had와 p.p. 사이에 와요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: If it snows tomorrow, we'll build a snowman.
Were I a bird, I could fly over the mountains.
The doctor suggested that she get some rest.
If you heat ice, it melts.
If I knew her address, I will send her a birthday card.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하는 가정법 과거이므로 주절은 would send가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He insisted that he had seen the man before.
The teacher demanded that every student hands in the essay by Friday.
If I had a car, I can drive you home.
I'll call you as soon as I will arrive at the airport.
The coach recommended that we not to eat too much before the game.
items.exp: 과거의 사실을 주장하는 insist는 당위가 아니므로 직설법 had seen이 옳아요. 나머지는 hand in, could, arrive, not eat으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: She proposed that the meeting be put off until next week.
If I were taller, I could join the basketball team.
Unless it rains, we'll go hiking.
What would you do if you won the lottery?
The witness insisted that the driver run the red light.
items.exp: 목격자는 운전자가 신호를 '위반했다'는 과거 사실을 주장한 것이라 당위의 원형이 아니라 ran(또는 had run)을 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: If he would have more time, he would learn to cook.
It is essential that everyone wear a helmet.
If I were you, I wouldn't trust him.
If you see Mina, tell her to call me.
I wonder if she will come to the party tomorrow.
items.exp: 가정법 과거의 if절에는 과거형 had를 써요. wonder 뒤 if절은 '~인지'라는 명사절이라 will come이 옳아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I were rich, I would help the poor.
(b) The manager ordered that the room be cleaned at once.
(c) If it will be sunny tomorrow, we'll go fishing.
(d) Were he here, he would agree with me.
(e) She suggested that we should take a break.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거 형태가 맞아요. (b) 옳음: 명령 동사 뒤 that절에 (should) be cleaned예요. (c) 틀림: 조건 부사절은 현재로 미래를 나타내 is예요. (d) 옳음: if를 생략하고 Were+주어로 도치했어요. (e) 옳음: 제안 동사 뒤 should+원형이 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I lived near the sea, I could swim every day.
(b) It is important that he be honest with his parents.
(c) He insisted that the rumor was not true.
(d) If I am you, I would accept the offer.
(e) They requested that the music is turned down.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거 형태가 맞아요. (b) 옳음: important 뒤 that절에 (should) be가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: 사실에 대한 주장이라 직설법 was가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 가정법 과거라 were예요. (e) 틀림: 요청 동사 뒤 that절은 (should) be turned down이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If you won't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
(b) If she studied harder, she might get better grades.
(c) The law requires that drivers wear seat belts.
(d) The police officer insisted that the man show his ID card.
(e) If I knew the answer, I would told you.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 조건 부사절은 현재로 미래를 나타내 don't hurry예요. (b) 옳음: 가정법 과거로 might+원형이 맞아요. (c) 옳음: 요구 동사 뒤 that절에 (should) wear예요. (d) 옳음: '~해야 한다'는 당위의 주장이라 (should) show가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: 조동사 뒤에는 원형 tell이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If he were here now, he could explain it.
(b) She advised that I not tell anyone.
(c) If I have a million dollars, I would buy an island.
(d) I'll wait here until you will come back.
(e) The doctor recommended that he exercises regularly.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거 형태가 맞아요. (b) 옳음: 충고 동사 뒤 (should) not tell이에요. (c) 틀림: 가정법 과거라 had예요. (d) 틀림: 시간 부사절은 현재로 미래를 나타내 come이에요. (e) 틀림: 권고 동사 뒤 that절은 (should) exercise예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Were I in your shoes, I would do the same.
(b) If I were a teacher, I will never give homework.
(c) He demanded that the money be returned.
(d) It is necessary that every child learn to swim.
(e) Unless you don't leave now, you'll be late.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: if 생략 도치 Were I가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 가정법 과거 주절은 would예요. (c) 옳음: 요구 동사 뒤 (should) be returned예요. (d) 옳음: necessary 뒤 that절에 (should) learn이에요. (e) 틀림: unless에 이미 부정이 있어 Unless you leave예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I don't know if it will rain tomorrow.
(b) If it rains tomorrow, the game will be canceled.
(c) If she had time, she would visit her grandparents more often.
(d) The teacher insisted that we be quiet in the library.
(e) Were it sunny today, we will go to the beach.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: '~인지'라는 명사절이라 will이 맞아요. (b) 옳음: 조건 부사절이라 현재 rains가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: 가정법 과거 형태가 맞아요. (d) 옳음: 당위의 주장이라 (should) be가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: 가정법 과거 주절은 would go예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If I (am / were) in your place, I would tell the truth.
(B) She insisted that she (had paid / pay) the bill already.
(C) They proposed that the festival (be held / was held) in May.
items.exp: (A) 가정법 과거라 were, (B) 이미 돈을 냈다는 사실 주장이라 had paid, (C) 제안 동사 뒤 (should) be held예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If it (snows / will snow) tonight, the roads will be icy tomorrow.
(B) I wonder if it (snows / will snow) tonight.
(C) If it snowed tonight, the roads (will / would) be icy tomorrow.
items.exp: (A) 조건 부사절은 현재로 미래를 나타내 snows, (B) '~인지'의 명사절은 미래를 will로 나타내 will snow, (C) if절이 과거형인 가정법 과거라 would예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The coach demanded that every player (arrive / arrives) on time.
(B) (Were / Was) I you, I wouldn't do that.
(C) If I (knew / know) his number, I could call him now.
items.exp: (A) 요구 동사 뒤 (should) arrive, (B) if 생략 도치는 Were I, (C) 가정법 과거라 knew예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I don't know [if] he will join us.
choices: [If] you need help, just call me.
[If] I were you, I'd say sorry.
Can you tell me [if] the store is open today?
You can go out [if] you finish your homework.
items.exp: <보기>의 if는 '~인지'라는 뜻으로 명사절을 이끌어요. tell의 목적어 역할을 하는 if도 같고, 나머지는 '만약 ~라면'이라는 조건·가정의 부사절이에요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As I am not tall enough, I can't reach the top shelf.
items.s: ___ tall enough, I could reach the top shelf.
items.exp: 가정법 과거 If I were에서 if를 생략하면 Were I로 도치해요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As they are busy, they can't help us.
items.s: If they ___ busy, they could help us.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거 were not을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 선생님은 모든 학생이 매일 일기를 써야 한다고 주장했다.
items.s: The teacher insisted that every student ___ every day.
items.exp: 당위를 주장하는 insist 뒤 that절에는 (should)+동사원형을 써요. should를 생략해도 keep은 원형이에요. '일기를 쓰다'는 keep a diary로 나타내요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The manager demanded that the report [is submitted] by noon. → ___
items.exp: 요구 동사 demand 뒤 that절에는 (should)+동사원형이 와서 be submitted예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 다리가 수리된다면 우리는 학교에 더 빨리 갈 수 있을 텐데. (지금은 수리되지 않았다)
items.s: We could get to school faster if the bridge ___.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대인 가정법 과거이고, 다리는 '수리되는' 대상이라 were repaired예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: If I [will have] time this weekend, I'll visit my grandparents. → ___
items.exp: 조건 부사절에서는 현재시제로 미래를 나타내요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Had she left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the train.
If I had known you were sick, I would visit you yesterday.
If you should need anything, just let me know.
If I had eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
If the sun were to disappear, all life on Earth would die.
items.exp: 어제(과거) 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료 would have visited가 되어야 해요. now가 있는 혼합가정법은 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Had I knew the answer, I would have told you.
If she had studied harder, she would pass the exam last year.
If I took the subway, I wouldn't have been late this morning.
Should you will have any questions, call me.
If he hadn't broken his leg, he would be playing in the final today.
items.exp: 과거에 다리를 다친 일이 현재(today)에 영향을 주는 혼합가정법이라 옳아요. 나머지는 Had I known, would have passed, had taken, Should you have로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: If it should rain tomorrow, the picnic will be put off.
Were the earth to stop spinning, what would happen?
If she had taken my advice, she would not be in trouble now.
Had it not been so foggy, the plane could have landed.
If we had not missed the bus, we would have been at home now.
items.exp: now가 있어 현재 결과를 나타내는 혼합가정법이므로 주절은 would be가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: If I would have had a map, I wouldn't have gotten lost.
If I were a better cook, I would invite you to dinner.
Had you told me earlier, I could have helped you.
If I hadn't stayed up late, I wouldn't be so tired now.
If you were to win the prize, what would you buy?
items.exp: 가정법 과거완료의 if절은 had+p.p.이므로 had had가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: If you had come to the party, you would enjoy it.
Had not I been tired, I would have gone out.
Should you see him, please give him this letter.
If I were to be born again, I will be a doctor.
If he had saved money then, he would have been rich now.
items.exp: If you should see him에서 if를 생략한 도치로 옳아요. 나머지는 would have enjoyed, Had I not been, would be, would be로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I had known his number, I would have called him.
(b) Had he been there, he would help us then.
(c) If she should come, please let me know.
(d) If I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't feel sick now.
(e) If we had left earlier, we would catch the 7 o'clock train yesterday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료 형태가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: then(그때)의 일이라 would have helped예요. (c) 옳음: 가능성이 낮은 미래는 should를 쓰고 주절에 명령문도 올 수 있어요. (d) 옳음: 과거 원인, 현재 결과의 혼합가정법이에요. (e) 틀림: yesterday의 일이라 would have caught예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Had I had more time, I could have finished the test.
(b) If he had followed the doctor's advice, he would be healthier now.
(c) If you were to fail, would you try again?
(d) If I had saved more money, I could buy a car last month.
(e) Should the weather be bad, the game will be canceled.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: If I had had에서 if를 생략한 도치예요. (b) 옳음: 혼합가정법이 맞아요. (c) 옳음: were to 가정법 미래가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: last month의 일이라 could have bought예요. (e) 옳음: If the weather should be bad의 도치이고 주절에 will도 가능해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I had gone to bed earlier, I wouldn't be sleepy now.
(b) If it had not been raining, we would have gone out.
(c) Had I not missed the train, I would be at home now.
(d) If I were to live on Mars, I would miss my family.
(e) If he has taken the medicine, he would have gotten better.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 혼합가정법이 맞아요. (b) 옳음: 과거완료진행의 가정법 과거완료가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: 도치된 혼합가정법이 맞아요. (d) 옳음: were to 가정법 미래가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: 가정법 과거완료라 had taken이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If I had been there, I would have helped you.
(b) If she had married him, she would be living in Canada now.
(c) Had you asked me, I will help you.
(d) If you should change your mind, let me know.
(e) If we had taken the right road, we would have arrived an hour ago.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료가 맞아요. (b) 옳음: 혼합가정법(현재진행 결과)이 맞아요. (c) 틀림: 가정법 과거완료라 would have helped예요. (d) 옳음: 가정법 미래 should가 맞아요. (e) 옳음: 과거 사실의 반대라 would have arrived예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If I had had enough money, I would have bought the jacket.
(b) Had it not been for your help, I would fail last year.
(c) If I had listened to you, I would not be in trouble now.
(d) If you were to meet the president, what will you say?
(e) If he had taken the job, he would have moved to Busan.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: had had가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: last year의 일이라 would have failed예요. (c) 옳음: 혼합가정법이 맞아요. (d) 틀림: were to 가정법 미래의 주절은 would예요. (e) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료가 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Had I not been sick, I would have joined the trip.
(b) If she studied abroad last year, her English would be better now.
(c) Should you have any questions, feel free to ask.
(d) If I had been born in Spain, I would speak Spanish now.
(e) If he did not help me then, I would not have finished it on time.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: If I had not been에서 if를 생략한 도치예요. (b) 틀림: last year의 일이라 if절은 had studied예요. (c) 옳음: If you should have의 도치예요. (d) 옳음: 혼합가정법이 맞아요. (e) 틀림: then(과거)의 일이라 had not helped예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If I had studied harder last year, I (would have entered / would enter) a better school.
(B) If I had studied harder last year, I (would have been / would be) a college student now.
(C) (Had / Should) it not been for the rain, we would have finished the game.
choices: would have entered – would be – Had
would have entered – would have been – Had
would have entered – would be – Should
would enter – would have been – Should
items.exp: (A) 작년 일의 결과라 가정법 과거완료, (B) now가 있어 혼합가정법 would be, (C) If it had not been for의 도치라 Had예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If you (should / would) have any problems, call me at once.
(B) If you (had taken / took) a taxi, you would have arrived on time.
(C) (Had / Were) I known about it, I would have told you.
items.exp: (A) 가능성이 낮은 미래의 가정은 should, (B) 주절이 would have p.p.라 had taken, (C) If I had known의 도치라 Had예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If I (had / had had) a car then, I would have driven you home.
(B) If she had not lost her passport, she (would be / would have been) in Paris now.
(C) If you had left at six, you (would have caught / would catch) the train.
choices: had – would be – would have caught
had had – would have been – would have caught
had had – would be – would catch
had had – would be – would have caught
had – would have been – would catch
items.exp: (A) then의 일이라 had had, (B) now가 있는 혼합가정법이라 would be, (C) 과거에 기차를 놓친 일의 반대라 would have caught예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As I didn't know the truth, I couldn't tell you.
items.s: If I had known the truth, I ___ you.
items.exp: 과거 사실의 반대인 가정법 과거완료이고, couldn't(할 수 없었다)에 맞춰 could have told예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: If I had been there, I would have stopped the fight.
items.s: ___ there, I would have stopped the fight.
items.exp: 가정법 과거완료에서 if를 생략하면 Had+주어+p.p.로 도치해요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As I didn't take the medicine, I feel sick now.
items.s: If I had taken the medicine, I ___ sick now.
items.exp: 과거 사실이 현재에 영향을 주는 혼합가정법이라 주절은 would+원형이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 만약 네가 다시 태어난다면, 너는 무엇이 되고 싶니?
items.s: If you ___, what would you like to be?
items.exp: 실현 가능성이 거의 없는 미래는 were to로 나타내고, '태어나다'는 수동 be born이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: If she [has listened] to me, she wouldn't have made that mistake. → ___
items.exp: 주절이 wouldn't have p.p.인 가정법 과거완료이므로 if절은 had listened예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 만약 그 편지가 제때 배달되었더라면, 그는 지금 여기 와 있을 텐데.
items.s: If the letter ___ on time, he would be here now.
items.exp: 과거 사실의 반대이고 편지는 '배달되는' 대상이라 가정법 과거완료 수동 had been delivered예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It's time we went home; it's getting dark.
Without water, no living thing could survive.
I wish I had listened to my parents back then.
She talks as if she has been to every country in Europe, but she hasn't.
If it were not for your support, I would give up.
items.exp: 실제로는 가 본 적이 없는 과거 경험을 반대로 가정하므로 as if+가정법 과거완료 had been이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I wish I bought that jacket when it was on sale.
But for the seat belt, he would have been badly hurt in the accident.
It's high time you start studying for the exam.
Had it not been for the map, we would get lost yesterday.
I studied hard; otherwise I would fail the test.
items.exp: But for는 '~이 없었다면'이고 과거 사고의 일이라 would have been이 옳아요. 나머지는 had bought, started, would have gotten lost, would have failed로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: I wish I were as tall as my older brother.
She acted as though nothing had happened.
A true friend would not say such a thing.
If only I had known about it earlier!
If it were not for his help last year, I would have failed.
items.exp: 작년(과거) 도움이 없었다면을 가정하므로 If it had not been for(또는 Had it not been for)가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Without your advice, I would make a big mistake last week.
To hear him speak English, you would think he was American.
I wish it would stop raining.
He treats me as if I were a child.
It's about time we left for the airport.
items.exp: last week(과거)의 일이므로 would have made가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: But for his help, I could not finish the work yesterday.
It's time the children go to bed.
I wish I had not said such rude things to her yesterday.
I wish I would have met you earlier.
Were it not for the sun, nothing can live on Earth.
items.exp: 어제 한 일을 후회하므로 I wish+가정법 과거완료가 옳아요. 나머지는 could not have finished, went, had met, could로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wish I lived closer to school.
(b) He acts as if he were the boss.
(c) Without the rain, the flowers would die.
(d) It's time you went to see a doctor.
(e) I wish I had gone to the concert last night.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재 이룰 수 없는 소망이라 가정법 과거예요. (b) 옳음: 현재 사실의 반대라 as if+가정법 과거예요. (c) 옳음: Without(~이 없다면)+가정법 과거 주절이에요. (d) 옳음: It's time 뒤에는 가정법 과거 went예요. (e) 옳음: 과거 일의 후회라 가정법 과거완료예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d), (e) 5개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wish I were taller.
(b) If it were not for air, we could not live.
(c) But for your help, I would have lost my way.
(d) I wish I have a pet dog.
(e) He talks as though he had met the singer, but he never did.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: I wish+가정법 과거예요. (b) 옳음: If it were not for는 '~이 없다면'이에요. (c) 옳음: 과거 일에 대한 가정이라 would have lost예요. (d) 틀림: I wish 뒤에는 가정법 과거 had예요. (e) 옳음: 과거 사실의 반대라 had met이 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Without your help, I could not have done it.
(b) I wish I had studied harder when I was young.
(c) If it had not been for the fog, the accident would not happen.
(d) A wise man would not do such a thing.
(e) I hurried; otherwise I would miss the train.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거 일에 대한 가정이라 could not have done이에요. (b) 옳음: 과거 후회라 가정법 과거완료예요. (c) 틀림: 과거 사고에 대한 가정이라 would not have happened예요. (d) 옳음: 주어에 가정의 뜻이 담긴 가정법 과거예요. (e) 틀림: 과거에 서두른 일이라 would have missed예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If only I could see her again!
(b) I wish I didn't eat so much last night.
(c) He spoke as if he had been there.
(d) Were it not for water, we could not survive.
(e) It's time we start the meeting.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: If only+가정법 과거예요. (b) 틀림: last night의 후회라 hadn't eaten이에요. (c) 옳음: 과거보다 앞선 일의 반대라 had been이에요. (d) 옳음: If it were not for의 도치예요. (e) 틀림: It's time 뒤에는 과거형 started예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Without his advice, I would have failed.
(b) I wish I could have gone with you yesterday.
(c) She talked as if she knew the answer, but she didn't.
(d) Had it not been for the bridge, we couldn't cross the river yesterday.
(e) I wish it stops snowing soon.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거 일에 대한 가정이라 would have failed예요. (b) 옳음: 과거 일에 대한 아쉬움이라 could have gone이에요. (c) 옳음: 주절과 같은 때의 반대라 as if+과거 knew예요. (d) 틀림: yesterday의 일이라 couldn't have crossed예요. (e) 틀림: I wish 뒤 미래 소망은 would stop이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wish you were here with me now.
(b) But for his mistake, we would win the game last night.
(c) It's about time you got a job.
(d) He worked hard; otherwise he would have lost his job.
(e) He looks as if he had been sick for a long time.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재 소망이라 가정법 과거예요. (b) 틀림: last night의 일이라 would have won이에요. (c) 옳음: It's about time 뒤에는 과거형이에요. (d) 옳음: 과거 일이라 would have lost예요. (e) 옳음: 현재 모습에서 과거 일을 반대로 가정해 had been이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I wish I (knew / had known) her name when I met her.
(B) She talks as if she (were / had been) a famous singer now, but she isn't.
(C) It's high time you (go / went) to bed.
items.exp: (A) 만났던 과거의 일이라 had known, (B) 현재 사실의 반대라 were, (C) It's high time 뒤에는 과거형 went예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) (Without / With) the Internet, our lives would be very different.
(B) I left early; (otherwise / unless) I would have missed the bus.
(C) He looked as if he (had seen / has seen) a ghost.
items.exp: (A) '인터넷이 없다면'이라 Without, (B) '그렇지 않았다면'은 부사 otherwise, (C) looked보다 앞선 일의 가정이라 had seen이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) (Had / If) it not been for the doctor, she would have died.
(B) I wish I (can / could) fly like a bird.
(C) (But / Except) for the heavy traffic, we would have arrived earlier.
items.exp: (A) If it had not been for에서 if를 생략한 도치라 Had, (B) I wish+가정법 과거라 could, (C) '~이 없었다면'은 But for예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I'm sorry that I didn't keep my promise.
items.s: I wish ___ my promise.
items.exp: 과거 일에 대한 후회는 I wish+가정법 과거완료(had kept)로 나타내요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: In fact, they are not doctors, but they talk like doctors.
items.s: They talk as if ___.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 as if+가정법 과거 they were doctors예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: If it had not been for your help, I could not have finished it.
items.s: ___ your help, I could not have finished it.
items.exp: If를 생략하면 Had+주어+not been for로 도치해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이제 우리가 그 문제에 대해 무언가를 할 때이다.
items.s: It's time ___ about the problem.
items.exp: It's time 뒤 that절에는 가정법 과거(동사의 과거형)를 써서 we did something이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I wish I [have taken] more pictures during the trip last month. → ___
items.exp: 지난달 일에 대한 후회라 I wish+가정법 과거완료 had taken이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 마치 그 사고를 직접 보았던 것처럼 말했다. (실제로는 보지 못했다)
items.s: He talked as if he ___ the accident himself.
items.exp: 말한 시점보다 앞선 과거 사실의 반대이므로 as if+가정법 과거완료 had seen이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: This room is three times as large as mine.
The more you read, the more you learn.
My bag is twice as heavy as yours.
She is much smarter than I thought.
The climate of Korea is milder than Russia.
items.exp: 비교 대상은 '한국의 기후'와 '러시아의 기후'이므로 than that of Russia가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: No other student in our class runs faster than Jiho.
This is one of the most popular song in the world.
The faster you drive, the most dangerous it becomes.
She is superior than me in math.
It's getting more and more hot.
items.exp: No other+단수명사 ~ 비교급 than은 최상급 의미로 옳아요. 나머지는 songs, the more dangerous, superior to, hotter and hotter로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The ears of a rabbit are longer than those of a cat.
Please call me back as soon as possible.
I'd rather walk than take a crowded bus.
This year's festival was even more exciting than last year's.
Jupiter is bigger than any other planets in the solar system.
items.exp: '비교급+than any other' 뒤에는 단수명사가 와서 any other planet이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Of the two sisters, Jenny is the tallest.
The more careful you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
This bridge is four times longer than that one.
Tom is not as diligent as his sister.
I prefer reading books to watching TV.
items.exp: 둘 중에서 비교할 때는 'the+비교급'을 써서 the taller가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: My grades are higher than my brother.
The older he grew, the wise he became.
The weather in July is hotter than that in May.
This is the more interesting book I've ever read.
She speaks English as fluent as a native speaker.
items.exp: that이 the weather를 받아 비교 대상이 일치해서 옳아요. 나머지는 my brother's, the wiser, the most interesting, fluently로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The book is not so interesting as the movie.
(b) My room is twice as big as yours.
(c) The higher we climbed, the colder it got.
(d) Her voice is more beautiful than any other singer.
(e) He runs faster than anyone else on the team.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: not so(as) ~ as는 '~만큼 …하지 않은'이에요. (b) 옳음: 배수+as 원급 as가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: the 비교급, the 비교급이 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 목소리끼리 비교해야 하므로 than that of any other singer예요. (e) 옳음: 비교급+than anyone else는 최상급 의미예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The days are getting longer and longer.
(b) He is the most diligent of all the workers.
(c) I prefer tea than coffee.
(d) This is the oldest building in the town.
(e) The new phone is more lighter than the old one.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 비교급 and 비교급이 맞아요. (b) 옳음: 최상급+of all이 맞아요. (c) 틀림: prefer A to B라서 to coffee예요. (d) 옳음: 최상급+in 장소가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: light의 비교급은 lighter라 more를 빼야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Nothing is more important than health.
(b) Try to answer as quickly as you can.
(c) The traffic in Seoul is heavier than Busan.
(d) Minsu is smarter than all the other boys in his class.
(e) He is the tallest than any other boy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부정주어+비교급 than은 최상급 의미예요. (b) 옳음: as 원급 as one can이 맞아요. (c) 틀림: 교통끼리 비교해야 하므로 than that in Busan이에요. (d) 옳음: 비교급+than all the other+복수명사가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: than 앞에는 비교급 taller예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The sooner you start, the earlier you will finish.
(b) This house is much bigger than that one.
(c) She has three times as many books as I do.
(d) He is one of the greatest artist of our time.
(e) The more he thought, the worse his headache became.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the 비교급, the 비교급이 맞아요. (b) 옳음: much가 비교급을 강조해요. (c) 옳음: 배수+as many+명사+as가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: one of the+최상급 뒤에는 복수명사 artists예요. (e) 옳음: bad의 비교급 worse가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Her English is as good as a native speaker's.
(b) This river is longer than any other rivers in the country.
(c) I would rather die than give up.
(d) The more you exercise, healthier you become.
(e) She is less taller than her sister.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 소유격으로 영어끼리 비교해 옳아요. (b) 틀림: any other 뒤에는 단수 river예요. (c) 옳음: would rather A than B(동사원형)가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 뒤에도 the를 붙여 the healthier예요. (e) 틀림: less 뒤에는 원급이 와서 less tall이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Few things are as precious as time.
(b) My score was lower than him.
(c) No other boy in the class is as tall as Junho.
(d) The ears of an elephant are bigger than that of a horse.
(e) This sofa is far more comfortable than that one.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부정주어+as 원급 as는 최상급 의미예요. (b) 틀림: 점수끼리 비교해야 하므로 his예요. (c) 옳음: No other+단수명사+as 원급 as가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 복수 ears를 받으므로 those예요. (e) 옳음: far가 비교급을 강조해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The salary of a doctor is higher than (that / those) of a teacher.
(B) The harder you work, (the more / more) you earn.
(C) Mina is taller than any other (girl / girls) in her class.
items.exp: (A) 단수 salary를 받는 that, (B) the 비교급, the 비교급이라 the more, (C) any other 뒤에는 단수 girl이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) He is (very / even) more famous than his father.
(B) Your phone is three times as expensive as (me / mine).
(C) I would rather stay home (than / to) go out.
items.exp: (A) 비교급 강조는 even, (B) 휴대폰끼리 비교하므로 mine, (C) would rather A than B예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) It's getting (darker and darker / more and more dark).
(B) Of the two plans, I like the second one (better / best).
(C) She is one of the (kindest / kinder) people I know.
choices: more and more dark – better – kindest
more and more dark – best – kinder
items.exp: (A) 비교급 and 비교급은 darker and darker, (B) 둘 중 하나를 더 좋아하므로 better, (C) one of the+최상급+복수명사라 kindest예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 네가 더 많이 웃을수록, 너는 더 행복해질 것이다.
items.s: The more you smile, ___.
items.exp: '~할수록 더 …하다'는 the 비교급+주어+동사, the 비교급+주어+동사 구조예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 탑은 저 건물보다 세 배 더 높다.
items.s: This tower is ___ that building.
items.exp: 배수 표현은 배수사+as 원급 as로 나타내요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mt. Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
items.s: Mt. Everest is higher than ___ in the world.
items.exp: 최상급은 비교급+than any other+단수명사로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: No other student in my class is as kind as Yuna.
items.s: Yuna is ___ in my class.
items.exp: No other ~ as 원급 as는 비교급+than any other+단수명사로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The population of Seoul is larger than [Busan]. → ___
items.exp: 인구끼리 비교해야 하므로 the population을 받는 that of Busan이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The [hard] you study, the better grades you will get. → ___
items.exp: the 비교급, the 비교급 구조이므로 harder예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The books which my teacher recommended them were all helpful.
The house whose roof was damaged in the storm is being repaired now.
Whoever finishes the test first may leave the room.
I have two cousins, both of whom live in Canada.
What matters most is not the result but the effort.
items.exp: recommended의 목적어 역할을 관계대명사 which가 이미 하고 있으므로 them을 또 쓰면 안 돼요. 'both of whom'은 계속적 용법의 전치사+관계대명사로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The man that I spoke to him was very kind.
She lent me a pen, that I lost the next day.
The reasons he gave us was hard to believe.
Anyone who want to join the club should sign up by Friday.
He said nothing at all, which made me even more nervous.
items.exp: 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법 which는 옳아요. 나머지는 him 중복, 계속적 용법 that 불가, 주어 The reasons에 맞춰 were, 선행사 Anyone에 맞춰 wants로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Whoever arrives last has to clean the classroom.
She always gives away whatever she doesn't need.
Whatever happens, I will keep the promise what I made to you.
Choose whichever color you like; they are all the same price.
Whatever you may say, I won't change my mind.
items.exp: 선행사 the promise가 있으므로 what이 아니라 that(which)을 써야 해요. 앞의 Whatever happens는 양보의 복합관계대명사로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: This is the book which I told you about it yesterday.
This is the book about that I told you yesterday.
This is the book what I told you about yesterday.
This is the book about which I told you about yesterday.
This is the book about which I told you yesterday.
items.exp: 전치사 about을 관계대명사 앞으로 보낸 about which가 옳아요. it 중복, 전치사 뒤 that 불가, 선행사 뒤 what 불가, about 중복은 모두 틀려요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The girl whose bike was stolen reported it to the police.
(b) I bought a laptop, the screen of which is larger than mine.
(c) Everything that he told us turned out to be false.
(d) The students who was late had to stay after school.
(e) She is the only friend that I can share my secrets with.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 소유격 whose + 명사. (b) 옳음: the screen of which = whose screen. (c) 옳음: 선행사 everything 뒤에는 that을 즐겨 써요. (d) 틀림: 선행사 The students가 복수이므로 were. (e) 옳음: 목적격 관계대명사 that, 전치사 with는 뒤에 남을 수 있어요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) What surprised me most was his calm voice.
(b) The things what you said hurt her feelings.
(c) He failed the test again, which disappointed his parents.
(d) The hotel at which we stayed had a beautiful garden.
(e) This is the pen which I wrote the letter.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 선행사 없는 what절 주어 + 단수 was. (b) 틀림: 선행사 The things가 있으므로 that(which). (c) 옳음: 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법 which. (d) 옳음: stay at the hotel → at which. (e) 틀림: write with the pen이므로 with which (또는 which I wrote the letter with). 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Whoever wants a free sample can take one.
(b) There are many people whom I trust them.
(c) I met a man who said he knew my father.
(d) He didn't come to the party, that made Amy upset.
(e) The hill which top is covered with snow looks beautiful.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Whoever = Anyone who, 단수 wants. (b) 틀림: 목적어 them 중복 → them 삭제. (c) 옳음: 주격 관계대명사 who. (d) 틀림: 계속적 용법에는 that을 못 쓰므로 which. (e) 틀림: '그 언덕의 꼭대기'이므로 소유격 whose top. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The man that I met at the station was my old teacher.
(b) I have a friend whose father is a pilot.
(c) This is the house which my grandparents lived in it.
(d) He lost the watch, which his wife had given him.
(e) Whatever she cooks taste great.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 목적격 관계대명사 that. (b) 옳음: 소유격 whose. (c) 틀림: in의 목적어가 which이므로 it 삭제. (d) 옳음: 계속적 용법 which, 잃어버린 것보다 먼저 받았으니 had given. (e) 틀림: Whatever절 주어는 단수 취급 → tastes. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The only thing that matters is your safety.
(b) Give the message to whoever answers the phone.
(c) The bag what I left on the bus was found.
(d) The person to whom I sent the email hasn't replied yet.
(e) He has three sons, all of them became doctors.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the only가 붙은 선행사 + that. (b) 옳음: whoever절이 to의 목적어, 절 안에서는 주어 역할. (c) 틀림: 선행사 The bag → that(which). (d) 옳음: send the email to the person → to whom. (e) 틀림: 접속사가 없으므로 all of whom. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I can't believe what he did to his little brother.
(b) It is the best movie that I have ever seen.
(c) This is all what I can do for you now.
(d) The money which was found on the street were returned to its owner.
(e) She speaks three languages, which is very useful for her job.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 선행사 없는 what절이 believe의 목적어. (b) 옳음: 최상급 선행사 + that. (c) 틀림: 선행사 all이 있으므로 that. (d) 틀림: 주어 The money(셀 수 없음) → was returned. (e) 옳음: 앞 절 내용을 받는 which + 단수 is. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) He finally found the key ___ he had been looking for all morning.
(B) ___ he had been looking for all morning was in his coat pocket.
items.exp: (A)는 선행사 the key가 있으므로 that(which), (B)는 선행사가 없고 '그가 찾던 것'이 주어이므로 What이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The girl ___ painting won the first prize is my classmate.
(B) I have a lot of homework, ___ I should finish by tonight.
(C) ___ comes first will get a free drink.
items.exp: (A) '그 소녀의 그림'이므로 whose, (B) 계속적 용법에는 that을 못 쓰므로 which, (C) '먼저 오는 사람은 누구든지'이므로 Whoever예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> The song [that] she sang at the festival was beautiful.
choices: I know [that] he is telling the truth.
The cake [that] my mom baked was delicious.
The fact [that] she lied made me angry.
It is important [that] we arrive on time.
He was so tired [that] he fell asleep.
items.exp: <보기>는 sang의 목적어 역할을 하는 목적격 관계대명사 that이에요. 같은 것은 baked의 목적어가 빠진 관계대명사 that이고, 나머지는 뒤에 완전한 절이 오는 접속사 that이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> The boy [who] is sitting by the window is my brother.
choices: I wonder [who] will win the game.
Do you know [who] that tall man is?
I have an aunt [who] lives in Jeju.
items.exp: <보기>는 선행사 The boy를 꾸미는 주격 관계대명사예요. 같은 것은 선행사 an aunt를 꾸미는 who이고, 나머지는 '누가/누구'를 뜻하는 의문사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 어제 너에게 말했던 그 식당은 지금 문을 닫았다.
items.s: The restaurant ___ is closed now.
a: about which I told you yesterday
items.exp: tell you about the restaurant에서 전치사 about을 관계대명사 앞으로 보내 about which I told you yesterday로 써요. 전치사 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 누가 그 문을 열든, 경보가 울릴 것이다.
items.s: ___, the alarm will go off.
items.exp: '누가 ~하든'은 복합관계대명사 Whoever로 나타내고, 부사절 안에서는 미래 대신 현재시제를 쓰며 whoever는 단수 취급하므로 opens예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The scientist [whom research] was published last month will visit our school. → ___
items.exp: '그 과학자의 연구'라는 소유 관계이고 research 뒤에 동사가 바로 오므로 소유격 관계대명사 whose를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The paintings, most of [them] were done by her grandfather, hang in the living room. → ___
items.exp: 두 절을 잇는 접속사가 없으므로 대명사 them 대신 관계대명사 which를 써서 most of which로 고쳐요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: My uncle has two dogs. Both of them are very old.
items.s: My uncle has two dogs, ___.
a: both of which are very old
items.exp: Both of them을 계속적 용법의 관계대명사로 바꾸면 both of which가 되고, 선행사 two dogs가 복수이므로 are를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 학생들이 필요로 하는 것은 더 많은 연습 시간이다.
items.s: ___ more practice time.
items.exp: '~하는 것'은 선행사를 포함한 what으로 쓰고, 절 안에서는 주어 the students에 맞춰 need, what절 주어는 단수 취급하므로 is를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The days when we used to play together seems so long ago.
The town where I grew up has changed a lot since then.
The museum which we visited yesterday had a dinosaur exhibit.
That is how she managed to save so much money.
There are times when silence is the best answer.
items.exp: 관계부사절 when ~ together의 꾸밈을 받는 주어는 The days(복수)이므로 seem이어야 해요. visited 뒤에 목적어가 없으므로 which는 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I don't understand the way how he solved the problem.
The office in where she works is on the tenth floor.
The reason which he was absent was a bad cold.
Whenever you will need help, just call me.
However tired you are, you should brush your teeth before bed.
items.exp: 「However+형용사+주어+동사」는 옳아요. the way how는 함께 못 쓰고, in where는 in which나 where, 뒤가 완전한 절이므로 why(for which), 시간 부사절이므로 need로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: No matter how hard the test is, I won't give up.
Wherever you go, you will find kind people.
However the weather is bad, the game will go on.
You can visit us whenever it is convenient for you.
The hotel, where we stayed for a week, had a view of the sea.
items.exp: '아무리 ~하더라도'의 however는 바로 뒤에 형용사가 와야 하므로 However bad the weather is로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: I visited Gyeongju, which I saw many old temples.
Sunday is the day which most shops close early.
He showed me the place where he had hidden the key there.
Do you know the reason for why she cried?
This is the house in which my grandfather lived.
items.exp: in which = where로 옳아요. 뒤가 완전한 절이므로 where, when(on which)이 필요하고, where가 있으면 there를 또 쓰지 않으며, for why는 why나 for which로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The library is a place where students can study quietly.
(b) I remember the year in which my little sister was born.
(c) This is the reason why I chose this school.
(d) That's the way how I learned to cook.
(e) The restaurant where we had dinner last night was crowded.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 장소 선행사 + 완전한 절. (b) 옳음: in which = when. (c) 옳음: 선행사 the reason + why. (d) 틀림: the way와 how는 함께 쓰지 않아요 → the way 또는 how. (e) 옳음: 장소 선행사 + 완전한 절. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) However you are rich, you can't buy happiness.
(b) Whenever I hear this song, I think of my grandmother.
(c) Wherever she goes, her dog follows her.
(d) No matter what you do, do your best.
(e) However carefully he drives, accidents can still happen.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: However rich you are 어순. (b) 옳음: whenever = '~할 때마다'. (c) 옳음: wherever = '어디에 가든'. (d) 옳음: no matter what = whatever. (e) 옳음: However+부사+주어+동사. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) This is the hospital which I was born.
(b) This is the hospital in which I was born.
(c) This is the hospital where I was born in.
(d) This is the hospital that I was born in.
(e) This is the hospital I was born in.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 뒤가 완전한 절 → where 또는 in which. (b) 옳음: 전치사+관계대명사. (c) 틀림: 관계부사 where에 이미 in의 뜻이 있어 in 삭제. (d) 옳음: 목적격 관계대명사 that + 전치사 in이 뒤에 남음. (e) 옳음: 목적격 관계대명사 생략. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Spring is the season when flowers bloom.
(b) I want to live in a city where has many parks.
(c) This is how he became a famous writer.
(d) She went to London, where she studied art for two years.
(e) He explained the reason how the accident happened.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간 선행사 + when. (b) 틀림: 뒤에 주어가 없는 불완전한 절 → which(that) has. (c) 옳음: the way 생략, how만 사용. (d) 옳음: 계속적 용법 where = and there. (e) 틀림: 선행사 the reason → why. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Come whenever you like.
(b) However you try hard, you can't move the rock alone.
(c) We arrived at noon, when the shop had just closed.
(d) Wherever you sit, you can see the stage clearly.
(e) The house which my uncle lives is near the river.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: whenever = '언제든지'. (b) 틀림: However hard you try 어순. (c) 옳음: 계속적 용법 when = and then, 도착 전에 닫혔으므로 had closed. (d) 옳음: wherever = '어디에 앉든'. (e) 틀림: 뒤가 완전한 절 → where 또는 in which. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I'll never forget the moment when I heard the news.
(b) There was a time when people didn't have phones.
(c) The way how he spoke made me uncomfortable.
(d) Whenever happens, I'll be on your side.
(e) This is the town in that I spent my childhood.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간 선행사 + when. (b) 옳음: 시간 선행사 + when. (c) 틀림: the way how 불가 → The way 또는 How. (d) 틀림: 주어가 빠진 자리이므로 복합관계대명사 Whatever. (e) 틀림: 전치사 뒤에 that 불가 → in which. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I visited the town ___ my father was born.
(B) I visited the town ___ my father talked about so often.
items.exp: (A)는 뒤가 완전한 절이므로 관계부사 where, (B)는 about의 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절이므로 관계대명사 which를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ hard he tried, he couldn't open the jar.
(B) You can sit ___ you like; there are many empty seats.
items.exp: (A) '아무리 열심히 해도'는 However hard, (B) '원하는 곳 어디든지' 앉으라는 뜻이므로 wherever예요. No matter는 how를 붙여야 해요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I remember the day [when] we first met.
choices: There are moments [when] I feel lonely.
I don't know [when] the concert starts.
[When] I was young, I lived in Busan.
items.exp: <보기>는 선행사 the day를 꾸미는 관계부사 when이에요. 같은 것은 선행사 moments를 꾸미는 when이고, 나머지는 의문사이거나 '~할 때'의 접속사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> This is the café [where] I often study.
choices: I asked him [where] he had bought the jacket.
We stayed at a hotel [where] the rooms were very clean.
items.exp: <보기>는 선행사 the café를 꾸미는 관계부사 where예요. 같은 것은 선행사 a hotel을 꾸미는 where이고, 나머지는 '어디'를 뜻하는 의문사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 그를 처음 만났던 그 날은 비가 많이 왔다.
items.s: The day ___ was very rainy.
items.exp: 시간 선행사 The day 뒤에 완전한 절이 오므로 관계부사 when을 쓰고, 과거의 일이므로 met이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 아무리 바빠도, 그녀는 매일 아침을 먹는다.
items.s: ___, she eats breakfast every day.
items.exp: '아무리 ~해도'는 「However+형용사+주어+동사」 어순이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: This is the stadium [which] the final game was held. → ___
items.exp: 뒤에 빠진 성분이 없는 완전한 수동태 절이므로 관계부사 where 또는 전치사+관계대명사(in which, at which)를 써야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I don't like [the way how] he talks to his parents. → ___
items.exp: the way와 how는 함께 쓸 수 없어서 둘 중 하나만 쓰거나 the way that, the way in which로 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I went to Jeju. I met my old friend there.
items.s: I went to Jeju, ___.
a: where I met my old friend
items.exp: there(= in Jeju)를 계속적 용법 관계부사 where로 바꿔 '그리고 거기서'의 뜻을 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리가 머물렀던 호텔들은 모두 해변 근처에 있었다.
items.s: The hotels ___ all near the beach.
items.exp: 장소 선행사 뒤 완전한 절이므로 where we stayed를 쓰고, 문장의 주어 The hotels가 복수이며 과거이므로 were예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Not only the players but also the coach was disappointed with the result.
Either you or your brother has to clean the garage.
Both the teacher and his students was surprised by the news.
Neither the children nor their mother likes spicy food.
Not the price but the colors were the problem.
items.exp: 「both A and B」는 항상 복수 취급하므로 were여야 해요. not only A but also B, either A or B, neither A nor B, not A but B는 B에 수를 맞춰요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Whether he will join us or not are not important.
I'll call you as soon as I will arrive at the airport.
Despite he was very tired, he kept working.
Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the train.
I wonder if the store will be open tomorrow.
items.exp: '~인지'의 명사절 if에서는 미래 일을 will로 써요. whether절 주어는 단수 취급(is), 시간 부사절은 현재시제(arrive), 절 앞은 Although, unless에는 부정이 이미 있으므로 hurry로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: She spoke so quietly that nobody could hear her.
It was such a hot day that we stayed indoors.
It was so a heavy box that I couldn't lift it.
He saved money so that he could buy a new bike.
Now that you are here, we can start the meeting.
items.exp: 명사가 있을 때는 「such a+형용사+명사」 또는 「so+형용사+a+명사」이므로 such a heavy box(so heavy a box)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
Because of it was snowing, the roads were slippery.
She stayed home although her bad cold.
If he is honest or not is not clear.
Whether you like it or not, you have to take the test.
items.exp: 양보의 부사절 Whether ~ or not은 옳아요. 조건 부사절은 rains, 절 앞은 Because, 명사구 앞은 despite(because of), 주어 자리의 '~인지'는 Whether로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'm not sure whether I locked the door.
(b) If she will come to the party is still a secret.
(c) The problem is that we don't have enough time.
(d) Once you learn to ride a bike, you never forget it.
(e) While I like coffee, my sister prefers tea.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: '~인지'의 명사절 whether. (b) 틀림: 주어 자리의 '~인지'는 if가 아니라 Whether. (c) 옳음: 보어 자리의 명사절 that. (d) 옳음: once = '일단 ~하면'. (e) 옳음: while = '~인 반면'. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Take an umbrella in case it rains.
(b) By the time he arrives, we will have finished dinner.
(c) Either Tom or his parents is going to pick you up.
(d) Although she was sick, but she went to school.
(e) He was so angry that he couldn't say a word.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: in case 절은 현재시제. (b) 옳음: 시간 부사절 현재 + 주절 미래완료. (c) 틀림: B(his parents)에 맞춰 are. (d) 틀림: Although와 but을 함께 쓰지 않아요 → but 삭제. (e) 옳음: so+형용사+that. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The fact which he lied made everyone angry.
(b) Neither he nor I are ready for the test.
(c) Both reading and writing is important.
(d) I will wait here until you will come back.
(e) She is not a singer but an actress.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 뒤가 완전한 절인 동격절 → that. (b) 틀림: B(I)에 맞춰 am. (c) 틀림: both A and B는 복수 → are. (d) 틀림: 시간 부사절은 현재시제 → come. (e) 옳음: not A but B = 'A가 아니라 B'. 따라서 옳은 것은 (e) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) As soon as the bell rang, the students ran out.
(b) You can borrow my bike as long as you return it by Friday.
(c) I don't know that he will come or not.
(d) Not only I but also my brother are good at math.
(e) Despite the rain, we enjoyed the trip.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: as soon as = '~하자마자'. (b) 옳음: 조건의 as long as + 현재시제. (c) 틀림: '~인지 아닌지'는 whether(if). (d) 틀림: B(my brother)에 맞춰 is. (e) 옳음: 전치사 despite + 명사. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It doesn't matter whether you win or lose.
(b) He worked hard so that he could pass the exam.
(c) She was such kind that everyone liked her.
(d) Neither my sister nor I am interested in sports.
(e) Because the heavy traffic, we were late.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 진주어 whether절. (b) 옳음: 목적의 so that ~ could. (c) 틀림: 명사가 없으므로 so kind. (d) 옳음: B(I)에 맞춰 am. (e) 틀림: 명사구 앞이므로 Because of. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Unless it rains, we will play soccer tomorrow.
(b) He asked me if or not I had seen the movie.
(c) She went to bed early because she was tired.
(d) Even though he is rich, but he is not happy.
(e) I'll tell him the news when he will come home.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 조건 부사절 현재시제. (b) 틀림: if 바로 뒤에 or not 불가 → whether or not. (c) 옳음: 이유의 접속사 because + 절. (d) 틀림: Even though와 but 중복 → but 삭제. (e) 틀림: 시간 부사절은 현재시제 → comes. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ the bad weather, the festival was a great success.
(B) ___ the weather was bad, the festival was a great success.
items.exp: (A)는 명사구 앞이므로 전치사 Despite, (B)는 절 앞이므로 접속사 Although를 써요. In spite는 of가 있어야 해요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) You won't pass the test ___ you study harder.
(B) I can't decide ___ to buy the blue one or the red one.
(C) It was ___ a nice day that we went on a picnic.
items.exp: (A) '더 열심히 하지 않으면'이므로 unless, (B) to부정사 앞에는 if를 못 쓰므로 whether, (C) a+형용사+명사 앞이므로 such예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I wonder [if] she got my message.
choices: [If] you need help, let me know.
Ask him [if] he can come to the party.
[If] I were you, I would apologize.
You can go out [if] you finish your homework.
items.exp: <보기>는 wonder의 목적어가 되는 '~인지'의 명사절 if예요. 같은 것은 ask의 목적어가 되는 if이고, 나머지는 '만약 ~라면'의 조건·가정 부사절이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> He believes [that] honesty is the best policy.
choices: The problem is [that] we have no money.
[That] she won the prize surprised us.
This is the bag [that] I bought yesterday.
It is true [that] he moved to Busan.
items.exp: <보기>와 나머지는 뒤에 완전한 절이 오는 명사절 접속사 that(목적어·보어·주어·진주어)이에요. 다른 것은 bought의 목적어가 빠진 관계대명사 that이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나도 내 친구들도 아직 그 소식을 듣지 못했다.
items.s: ___ the news yet.
a: Neither I nor my friends have heard
Neither my friends nor I have heard
items.exp: neither A nor B는 B(my friends)에 수를 맞추고, '아직 ~하지 못했다'는 현재완료이므로 have heard예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 너무 친절한 소년이라서 모두가 그를 좋아한다.
items.s: He is ___ that everyone likes him.
items.exp: 명사 boy가 있으므로 「such+a+형용사+명사+that」을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [Despite] she was tired, she helped me with my homework. → ___
items.exp: 뒤에 주어와 동사가 있는 절이 오므로 전치사 Despite 대신 양보의 접속사 Although(Though)를 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: If you don't leave now, you will be late.
items.s: ___ now, you will be late.
items.exp: unless는 '~하지 않으면'이라는 뜻이라 not을 또 쓰지 않고, 조건 부사절이므로 현재시제 leave를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 보고서가 완성되면 내가 너에게 보내 줄게.
items.s: I will send you the report once it ___.
items.exp: once가 이끄는 조건 부사절에서는 미래 대신 현재(완료)시제를 쓰고, 보고서는 '완성되는' 대상이므로 수동태예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 지난주에 학생들뿐만 아니라 선생님도 그 시험에 놀랐다.
items.s: Not only the students but also the teacher ___ by the test last week.
items.exp: not only A but also B는 B(the teacher)에 수를 맞추고, 지난주 일이며 '놀라게 된' 것이므로 was surprised예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Please finish the report until Friday.
We'll leave on the morning of July 3.
The store is open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.
He has lived here since he was ten.
I fell asleep during the movie.
items.exp: 보고서를 끝내는 것은 기한까지 '완료'되어야 하는 동작이므로 until이 아니라 by를 써야 해요. 특정한 날의 아침은 on을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I'm looking forward to see you again.
She is good at play the guitar.
Instead of take the bus, we walked.
He left without saying goodbye to anyone.
items.exp: 전치사 뒤에는 동명사를 쓰므로 without saying이 옳아요. 나머지도 전치사(to, at, of, for) 뒤이므로 seeing, playing, taking, helping으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: The cat hid under the bed.
The game was put off because of the storm.
He sat between she and her brother.
Divide the cake among the four children.
She has been sick for a week.
items.exp: 전치사 between의 목적어이므로 주격 she가 아니라 목적격 her를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: I'll be back in Monday morning.
We met in the evening of her birthday.
It has rained during three days.
The train will arrive in ten minutes.
items.exp: in+시간은 '~ 후에'라는 뜻으로 옳아요. 요일 아침은 on, 연도는 in, 특정한 날의 저녁은 on, 숫자로 된 기간은 for를 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) She stayed at home because of a bad cold.
(b) Despite of his efforts, he failed.
(c) In spite of the noise, the baby slept well.
(d) The flight was delayed due to the fog.
(e) Although the rain, we went hiking.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: because of + 명사구. (b) 틀림: despite는 of 없이 → Despite his efforts. (c) 옳음: in spite of + 명사. (d) 옳음: due to + 명사. (e) 틀림: 명사 앞이므로 Despite(In spite of). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He is interested in learning Chinese.
(b) I'm used to get up early.
(c) What do you say to going for a walk?
(d) She is proud of being a nurse.
(e) We objected to change the plan.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 전치사 in + 동명사. (b) 틀림: be used to의 to는 전치사 → getting. (c) 옳음: What do you say to -ing. (d) 옳음: 전치사 of + 동명사. (e) 틀림: object to의 to는 전치사 → changing. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I haven't seen him since last Christmas.
(b) We arrived at the airport two hours early.
(c) She has been waiting for him since 3 o'clock.
(d) The store will be closed until next Monday.
(e) Beside the old tree stands a small bench.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재완료 + since + 과거 시점. (b) 옳음: arrive at + 지점. (c) 옳음: wait for, since + 시점. (d) 옳음: 닫힌 상태의 계속 → until. (e) 옳음: beside = '~ 옆에', 장소 부사구 도치로 stands. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d), (e) 5개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I'll be there by six, so wait for me.
(b) She waited for him until midnight.
(c) He came back home at Christmas Eve.
(d) My birthday is in May.
(e) We go to church at Sunday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 도착 기한 → by. (b) 옳음: 기다림의 계속 → until. (c) 틀림: 특정한 날 → on Christmas Eve. (d) 옳음: 월 → in. (e) 틀림: 요일 → on Sunday(s). 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The book is divided into five chapters.
(b) He was absent from school yesterday.
(c) I'm worried about to fail the test.
(d) She apologized to me for being late.
(e) The movie reminds me with my childhood.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: be divided into. (b) 옳음: be absent from. (c) 틀림: 전치사 about 뒤 → failing. (d) 옳음: apologize to 사람 for -ing. (e) 틀림: remind A of B → of. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The money was shared among the two brothers.
(b) There is a bench between the two trees.
(c) He's been working here for 2015.
(d) We stayed in Busan during the summer vacation.
(e) She hasn't eaten anything for this morning.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 둘 사이 → between. (b) 옳음: 둘 사이 → between. (c) 틀림: 시점(2015) → since. (d) 옳음: 특정 기간 명사 → during. (e) 틀림: 시점(this morning) → since. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I have to hand in this report ___ Friday.
(B) The library will stay open ___ 10 p.m. tonight.
items.exp: (A)는 금요일까지 제출을 '완료'해야 하므로 by, (B)는 밤 10시까지 열려 있는 상태가 '계속'되므로 until이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) He has been sick ___ last Monday.
(B) He has been sick ___ five days.
(C) He was in the hospital ___ the holidays.
items.exp: (A) 시작 시점 앞은 since, (B) 숫자로 된 기간 앞은 for, (C) 특정 기간 명사 앞은 전치사 during이에요. while은 접속사라 명사 앞에 못 써요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I'm looking forward [to] meeting you.
choices: I went to the store [to] buy milk.
items.exp: <보기>의 to는 뒤에 동명사가 오는 전치사예요. 같은 것은 be used to(-ing)의 전치사 to이고, 나머지는 동사원형이 오는 to부정사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> She works [as] a nurse at the hospital.
choices: [As] it was late, we went home.
[As] he grew older, he became quieter.
He is known [as] a great cook.
items.exp: <보기>는 명사 앞에서 '~로서'를 뜻하는 전치사 as예요. 같은 것은 a great cook 앞의 전치사 as이고, 나머지는 뒤에 절이 오는 접속사(이유, 방식, 비례, 동시)예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 우산을 가져오는 대신 비옷을 입었다.
items.s: ___, he wore a raincoat.
items.exp: instead of는 전치사구이므로 뒤에 동명사 bringing을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She has been studying English [since] three years. → ___
items.exp: three years는 시작 시점이 아니라 기간이므로 since가 아니라 for를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I'm looking forward to [hear] from you soon. → ___
items.exp: look forward to의 to는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사 hearing을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 경기는 폭우에도 불구하고 계속되었다.
items.s: The game continued ___.
items.exp: 명사구 앞에서 '~에도 불구하고'는 전치사 despite를 쓰고, of를 붙이지 않아요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Although she was sick, she went to work.
items.s: In spite of ___, she went to work.
items.exp: in spite of는 전치사이므로 절 대신 동명사구 being sick을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 과제는 다음 주 월요일까지 제출되어야 한다.
items.s: The assignment ___ next Monday.
items.exp: 과제는 '제출되는' 대상이라 must be submitted, 기한까지 완료되어야 하므로 by를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The number of students who walk to school is increasing.
The key to the doors of the old classrooms are missing.
A number of students in my class walk to school.
The rich are not always happier than the poor.
Ten kilometers is a long distance to walk.
items.exp: 주어의 핵심은 The key(단수)이고 to the doors of the old classrooms는 수식어구이므로 is여야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Every boy and girl in the class have a locker.
The police is looking into the case.
Playing computer games for hours are bad for your eyes.
Half of the apples in the box were rotten.
items.exp: 「half of+명사」는 뒤 명사(the apples)에 맞추므로 were가 옳아요. every A and B는 단수(has), 학과명은 단수(is), the police는 복수(are), 동명사구 주어는 단수(is)예요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: What we need now is more time.
There are a lot of reasons to be careful.
The students who lives in the dormitory must follow the rules.
Many a student has dreamed of studying abroad.
Some of the milk has gone bad.
items.exp: 주격 관계대명사절의 동사는 선행사 The students(복수)에 맞춰 live여야 해요. 「many a+단수명사」는 단수 취급하므로 has는 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The rest of the cookies was eaten by the kids.
One of my friends live in Canada.
Either my parents or my sister are coming.
Each of the answers have a different score.
Around the corner are two small bakeries.
items.exp: 장소 부사구가 앞으로 나간 도치문으로 주어 two small bakeries에 맞춘 are가 옳아요. the rest of the cookies는 were, one of는 lives, either A or B는 B에 맞춰 is, each of는 has예요.

items.q: 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The cost of the repairs on both cars was higher than expected.
Not only the actors but also the director were invited.
Many people who visit the island every summer enjoy the beaches.
The girls I met at the camp each have a different hobby.
The students, as well as the teacher, were tired.
items.exp: 「not only A but also B」는 B(the director)에 수를 맞추므로 was여야 해요. B as well as A는 B(The students)에 맞추므로 were가 옳아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Two-thirds of the land is covered with forests.
(b) The news about the accident were shocking.
(c) Why she left so early is still a mystery.
(d) Bread and butter is my usual breakfast.
(e) The elderly needs more support from society.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 분수 of + 단수명사(the land) → is. (b) 틀림: news는 단수 → was. (c) 옳음: 명사절 주어 → 단수. (d) 옳음: 하나의 음식(버터 바른 빵) → 단수. (e) 틀림: the+형용사 = 노인들(복수) → need. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) To make good friends takes time.
(b) There is many books on the shelf.
(c) The boy as well as his parents are waiting outside.
(d) Not only you but also he have to apologize.
(e) Most of the students was absent.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: to부정사구 주어 → 단수. (b) 틀림: 주어 many books → are. (c) 틀림: B as well as A는 B(The boy) → is. (d) 틀림: B(he)에 맞춰 has. (e) 틀림: most of + 복수명사 → were. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Each student have to bring a lunch.
(b) The number of cars on the roads are growing.
(c) A lot of the furniture were damaged.
(d) Mathematics are difficult for many students.
(e) The pictures that he took in Spain is beautiful.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: each + 단수명사 → has. (b) 틀림: the number of → 단수 is. (c) 틀림: furniture는 셀 수 없음 → was. (d) 틀림: 학과명 → is. (e) 틀림: 주어 The pictures → are. 따라서 옳은 것은 0개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The book on the desk belongs to my brother.
(b) Writing letters by hand are becoming rare.
(c) All of the information was useful.
(d) The people in this town is very friendly.
(e) There are a few problems with the plan.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주어 The book → belongs. (b) 틀림: 동명사구 주어 → is. (c) 옳음: information은 셀 수 없음 → was. (d) 틀림: people은 복수 → are. (e) 옳음: a few problems → are. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Each of the students was given a prize.
(b) The young is usually full of energy.
(c) What he said were true.
(d) Both my brother and I like soccer.
(e) A large number of fish live in this lake.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: each of → 단수. (b) 틀림: the young = 젊은이들 → are. (c) 틀림: what절 주어 → was. (d) 옳음: both A and B → 복수. (e) 옳음: a number of = 많은 → 복수. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Between the two buildings stands a tall tree.
(b) Here comes the bus!
(c) Among the guests was two famous singers.
(d) There seem to be a problem with the computer.
(e) Physics are not as hard as it looks.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 도치, 주어 a tall tree → stands. (b) 옳음: 도치, 주어 the bus → comes. (c) 틀림: 도치, 주어 two famous singers → were. (d) 틀림: 주어 a problem → seems. (e) 틀림: 학과명 → is. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The number of people who ___ abroad every year is increasing.
(B) Some of the money ___ stolen.
items.exp: (A) 관계사절 동사는 선행사 people(복수)에 맞춰 travel, (B) 「some of+명사」는 뒤 명사 the money(셀 수 없음)에 맞춰 was예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Twenty years ___ a long time to wait.
(B) The old man, along with his grandchildren, ___ sitting in the yard.
(C) A number of volunteers ___ helping clean the beach now.
items.exp: (A) 시간을 한 덩어리로 보면 단수 is, (B) along with ~는 수식어라 주어 The old man에 맞춰 is, (C) a number of(많은)+복수명사는 복수 are예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) There ___ some milk left in the fridge.
(B) The poor ___ often ignored by society.
items.exp: (A) there 구문은 뒤 주어 some milk(셀 수 없음)에 맞춰 is, (B) the poor는 '가난한 사람들'이라 복수 are예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 상자들 중 하나는 책으로 가득 차 있다.
items.s: One of the boxes ___ books.
items.exp: 「one of+복수명사」는 단수 취급하고, 상자는 '채워진' 상태이므로 is filled with예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The results of the survey we did last month [shows] that most students sleep too little. → ___
items.exp: 주어의 핵심은 The results(복수)이고 of ~ last month는 수식어구이므로 복수 동사 show(showed)를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Every one of the windows in the classrooms [were] broken during the storm. → ___
items.exp: 「every one of+복수명사」는 단수 취급하므로 was를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 공장의 노동자 수는 작년 이후로 줄어 왔다.
items.s: The number of workers at the factory ___ since last year.
items.exp: 「the number of」는 '~의 수'로 단수 취급하고, since last year가 있으므로 현재완료(진행)를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 선생님뿐만 아니라 학생들도 그 결과에 실망했다.
items.s: The students as well as the teacher ___ with the result.
items.exp: B as well as A는 B(The students)에 수를 맞추고, 과거에 '실망한' 것이므로 were disappointed예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 매일 일기를 쓰는 것은 너의 쓰기 실력을 향상시킨다.
items.s: ___ your writing skills.
a: Keeping a diary every day improves
items.exp: 동명사구 주어 Keeping a diary every day는 단수 취급하므로 improves를 써요. '일기를 쓰다'는 keep a diary예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: My teacher said that the moon goes around the earth.
She said that she will finish the work the following day.
She told me that she had lost her wallet the day before.
He said that he would call me the next morning.
I learned that the Second World War ended in 1945.
items.exp: 주절이 과거(said)이고 the following day는 과거 기준의 '다음 날'이므로 will을 would로 바꿔야 해요. 불변의 진리는 현재, 역사적 사실은 과거로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He told us that the sun rose in the east.
I knew that she has been ill since the previous week.
She said that she can't come to the party the next day.
He said that he is going to leave the next day.
They said that if they had time, they would help me.
items.exp: 종속절 속 가정법 과거는 시제 일치의 영향을 받지 않아요. 불변의 진리는 rises, 나머지는 주절 과거에 맞춰 had been, couldn't, was going to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: I thought that it would rain in the afternoon.
She asked me where I had bought my shoes.
She said that she has seen the movie two days before.
He said that he had been waiting for an hour.
I heard that she was going to move to Daejeon.
items.exp: 주절이 과거이고 말한 때보다 '이틀 전'의 일이므로 현재완료가 아니라 과거완료 had seen을 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: Our teacher told us that light traveled faster than sound.
I thought that he will come back the next day.
She told me that she has met him the previous week.
We learned that the first modern Olympics had been held in 1896.
My mom said that she would make pizza for dinner that night.
items.exp: 주절 과거에 맞춰 will을 would로 쓴 문장이 옳아요. 과학적 사실은 travels, 과거 기준 미래는 would, 그 전 주의 일은 had met, 역사적 사실은 과거시제 were held로 써야 해요.

items.q: 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
choices: I didn't know that he had already arrived.
I believed that she has told me the truth the day before.
She says that she lived in Canada when she was a child.
He thinks that it will snow tomorrow.
My dad said that time is money.
items.exp: 주절이 과거(believed)이고 그보다 하루 전의 일이므로 had told여야 해요. 주절이 현재이면 종속절은 내용에 맞는 시제를 자유롭게 쓰고, 속담은 현재로 써요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He said that he had been sick the day before.
(b) He said that he would be here by noon.
(c) The teacher explained that water froze at 0°C.
(d) I didn't know that she had already left.
(e) He told me that he had better go home early.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 말한 시점보다 앞선 일 → had been, yesterday → the day before. (b) 옳음: 주절 과거 → would. (c) 틀림: 과학적 사실 → freezes. (d) 옳음: 주절보다 앞선 일 → 과거완료. (e) 옳음: had better는 시제 일치의 영향을 받지 않아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I hoped that you would like the gift.
(b) She said that she had finished her homework an hour before.
(c) He told me that he will meet me the next day.
(d) They knew that the earth is round.
(e) She said that if she were rich, she would travel around the world.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주절 과거 → would. (b) 옳음: 말한 때보다 앞선 일 → 과거완료. (c) 틀림: 과거 기준의 다음 날 → would. (d) 옳음: 불변의 진리 → 현재. (e) 옳음: 가정법은 시제 일치 예외. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I heard that he had moved to Busan the month before.
(b) He said that he will be busy the following week.
(c) My grandfather told me that Hangeul had been created in 1443.
(d) The teacher said that two and two make four.
(e) He said that he was going to buy a new phone the next day.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 그 전 달의 일 → 과거완료. (b) 틀림: 과거 기준의 다음 주 → would. (c) 틀림: 역사적 사실 → was created. (d) 옳음: 수학적 진리 → 현재. (e) 옳음: 주절 과거 → was going to. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He said that he had lost his key the day before.
(b) I knew that she will come back the next day.
(c) We were taught that the earth went around the sun.
(d) She told me that she was hungry then.
(e) He said that he could ride a bike when he was five.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 그 전날의 일 → 과거완료. (b) 틀림: 과거 기준 미래 → would. (c) 틀림: 불변의 진리 → goes. (d) 옳음: 주절 과거 → was. (e) 옳음: 주절 과거 → could. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Mom said that I must be home by nine that night.
(b) He told me that he has finished the work the previous day.
(c) She said that she would wait for me the next morning.
(d) Our teacher said that the moon has no light of its own.
(e) He said that he is going to visit his aunt the next weekend.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: must는 그대로 쓸 수 있어요(had to도 가능). (b) 틀림: 그 전날의 일 → had finished. (c) 옳음: 주절 과거 → would. (d) 옳음: 과학적 사실 → 현재. (e) 틀림: 주절 과거 → was going to. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She said that she had been sick for three days.
(b) I thought that he has gone home already.
(c) He told me that he would rather stay home.
(d) They said that they had seen the movie the week before.
(e) She said that she can't attend the meeting the next day.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 말한 때까지 계속 → 과거완료. (b) 틀림: 주절 과거보다 앞선 일 → had gone. (c) 옳음: 주절 과거 → would rather. (d) 옳음: 그 전 주의 일 → 과거완료. (e) 틀림: 주절 과거 → couldn't. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) He said that he ___ me the next day.
(B) Our teacher said that the earth ___ around the sun.
items.exp: (A) 주절이 과거이고 '그 다음 날'이므로 would call, (B) 불변의 진리는 주절과 상관없이 현재 moves예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She told me that she ___ the book two days before.
(B) He said that if he ___ wings, he would fly to her.
(C) We learned that the war ___ in 1953.
items.exp: (A) 말한 때보다 이틀 전이므로 had read, (B) 가정법 과거는 그대로 had, (C) 역사적 사실은 항상 과거시제 ended예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) He promised that he ___ the money the following week.
