(B) I knew that she ___ there since the previous year.
items.exp: (A) 과거 기준의 '다음 주'이므로 would return, (B) 과거의 어느 때까지 계속된 일이므로 과거완료 had lived예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: She said to me, "I will call you tomorrow."
items.s: She said that ___.
a: she would call me the next day
she would call me the following day
items.exp: 간접화법에서 주절이 과거이므로 will은 would, I는 she, you는 me, tomorrow는 the next(following) day로 바꿔요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He said to me, "I lost my bag yesterday."
items.s: He told me that ___.
a: he had lost his bag the day before
he had lost his bag the previous day
items.exp: 말한 때보다 앞선 일이므로 과거완료 had lost를 쓰고, I·my는 he·his, yesterday는 the day before(the previous day)로 바꿔요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Our science teacher said that hot air [rose] because it is lighter than cold air. → ___
items.exp: 더운 공기가 올라가는 것은 언제나 성립하는 과학적 사실이므로 주절이 과거여도 현재시제 rises를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Jisu promised that she [will] return my umbrella the next day. → ___
items.exp: 주절이 과거(promised)이고 the next day는 과거 기준의 '다음 날'이므로 will을 would로 바꿔요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 다리가 그 전 해에 수리되었다는 것을 들었다.
items.s: I heard that the bridge ___ the previous year.
items.exp: 들은 때(과거)보다 앞선 일이므로 과거완료이고, 다리는 '수리되는' 대상이므로 수동태 had been repaired예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 자기가 나라면 그 제안을 받아들일 거라고 말했다.
items.s: He said that he ___ the offer if he were me.
items.exp: 종속절 속 가정법 과거는 주절이 과거여도 그대로 쓰므로 「if+주어+were, 주어+would+동사원형」이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Not until last year he started learning to swim.
Never have I seen such a beautiful lake.
Little did she know that her friends were planning a party.
Only when I got home did I notice the broken window.
Hardly had we started the game when it began to rain.
items.exp: Not until ~이 문장 앞에 오면 주절이 「조동사+주어+동사원형」으로 도치되므로 did he start로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Rarely we eat out on weekdays.
On the table was lying a few old letters.
So difficult the test was that nobody passed.
Here comes he with the pizza.
Had I known the truth, I would have told you.
items.exp: If I had known에서 if를 생략하고 Had I known으로 도치한 문장이 옳아요. Rarely do we eat, 주어 a few old letters에 맞춘 were, So difficult was the test, Here he comes로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Not only did he lose his wallet, but he also missed the bus.
At the top of the hill stands an old church.
Seldom does she eats breakfast at home.
Should you need any help, please call me.
Such was the noise that we couldn't hear each other.
items.exp: 부정어 도치에서 조동사 does가 수·시제를 나타내므로 뒤의 동사는 원형 eat이어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: I don't like horror movies, and so do my brother.
Little I dreamed that I would win the prize.
Were he here, he will help us.
She can play the violin, and so can her sister.
items.exp: 긍정문 뒤 '~도 그렇다'는 「so+조동사+주어」로 옳아요. 부정문 뒤는 neither does my brother, Little did I dream, 대명사 주어는 도치하지 않으므로 Into the room she ran, 가정법이므로 would help로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 어법상 옳은 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Only when she smiled I felt relieved.
Behind the house is a small garden with many flowers.
So fast he ran that nobody could catch up with him.
Little he knew about the danger.
Never again I will trust him.
items.exp: 장소 부사구 도치에서 주어 a small garden에 맞춘 is가 옳아요. 나머지는 did I feel, did he run, did he know, will I trust로 도치해야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Only by working hard can you succeed.
(b) Never in my life I have felt so happy.
(c) In the middle of the lake is a small island.
(d) Not a single mistake did she make on the test.
(e) There goes the last train!
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Only+부사구 → 조동사+주어. (b) 틀림: have I felt로 도치. (c) 옳음: 장소 부사구 도치, 주어 a small island → is. (d) 옳음: 부정어가 포함된 목적어가 앞 → did she make. (e) 옳음: 명사 주어는 There+동사+주어. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Scarcely had he arrived when the meeting began.
(b) Under the tree were sitting an old man.
(c) Hardly I could believe my eyes.
(d) Here they come!
(e) He has never been to Europe, and neither have I.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Scarcely had+주어+p.p. ~ when. (b) 틀림: 주어 an old man → was. (c) 틀림: Hardly could I believe로 도치. (d) 옳음: 대명사 주어는 도치하지 않아요. (e) 옳음: 부정문 뒤 neither+have+주어. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Were I you, I would accept the offer.
(b) Should you will need more time, let me know.
(c) So kind was the nurse that every patient loved her.
(d) Not until I read the letter I knew the truth.
(e) Only after the class ended did she leave.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: If I were you의 if 생략 도치. (b) 틀림: If you should need의 if 생략 도치 → Should you need. (c) 옳음: So+형용사+be동사+주어. (d) 틀림: did I know로 도치. (e) 옳음: Only+부사절 → did she leave. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Little did I expect to see him there.
(b) Seldom has he been late for school.
(c) Along the river walks many people every evening.
(d) Never will I forget your kindness.
(e) Only yesterday I heard the news.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Little did+주어+동사원형. (b) 옳음: Seldom has+주어+p.p. (c) 틀림: 주어 many people → walk. (d) 옳음: Never will+주어. (e) 틀림: did I hear로 도치. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not only is she smart, but she is also kind.
(b) So tired he was that he fell asleep at once.
(c) Here is the book you asked for.
(d) Should it rain tomorrow, the game will be canceled.
(e) No sooner had she seen me than she runs away.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Not only+be동사+주어. (b) 틀림: So tired was he. (c) 옳음: 명사 주어 → Here is+주어. (d) 옳음: If it should rain의 if 생략 도치. (e) 틀림: 과거 일 → ran. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Rarely does he talk about his family.
(b) On the wall hang a picture of my grandparents.
(c) I was tired, and so was my sister.
(d) Never did I thought he would lie to me.
(e) She didn't go to the party, and so did I.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Rarely does+주어+동사원형. (b) 틀림: 주어 a picture → hangs. (c) 옳음: so+be동사+주어. (d) 틀림: did 뒤 동사원형 think. (e) 틀림: 부정문 뒤 → neither did I. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Not until the sun went down ___ home.
(B) Only after reading the review ___ to watch the movie.
choices: did we go – did I decide
items.exp: Not until ~과 Only+부사구가 문장 앞에 오면 주절은 「did+주어+동사원형」으로 도치되므로 did we go, did I decide예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Hardly ___ the house when it began to rain.
(B) ___ you see him, please give him this note.
(C) In front of the gate ___ two big dogs.
items.exp: (A) 「Hardly had+주어+p.p. ~ when」, (B) If you should see him의 if 생략 도치 Should, (C) 장소 부사구 도치에서 주어 two big dogs(복수)에 맞춰 lie예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She has finished her homework, and so ___ I.
(B) He doesn't eat meat, and neither ___ his wife.
items.exp: (A) 앞 동사가 현재완료이므로 so have I, (B) 앞이 일반동사 현재 부정문이고 주어 his wife가 단수이므로 neither does예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그렇게 아름다운 해변을 본 적이 없다.
items.s: Never ___ such a beautiful beach.
items.exp: 부정어 Never가 문장 앞에 오면 「조동사+주어+p.p.」로 도치해 have I seen이 돼요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I had no sooner arrived at the station than the train left.
items.s: No sooner ___ at the station than the train left.
items.exp: No sooner가 문장 앞으로 나가면 「had+주어+p.p.」로 도치해요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: If I had known his number, I would have called him.
items.s: ___ his number, I would have called him.
items.exp: 가정법 과거완료의 if를 생략하면 had가 주어 앞으로 나가 Had I known이 돼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Only after he graduated [he found] a job he liked. → ___
items.exp: Only+부사절이 문장 앞에 오면 주절은 「did+주어+동사원형」으로 도치해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 언덕 꼭대기에 오래된 나무 두 그루가 서 있다.
items.s: On the top of the hill ___.
items.exp: 장소 부사구가 앞에 오면 「동사+주어」로 도치하고, 주어 two old trees가 복수이므로 stand예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 그 소식을 듣고 나서야 비로소 울기 시작했다.
items.s: Not until she heard the news ___ to cry.
items.exp: '~하고 나서야 비로소'의 Not until이 앞에 오면 주절은 「did+주어+동사원형」으로 도치해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It was in this park that I first met her.
It is the children who is making all that noise.
It is my parents who always support me.
It was the blue bag that she bought at the mall.
It was not until midnight that he came home.
items.exp: 강조구문의 who절 동사는 강조된 말 the children(복수)에 맞춰야 하므로 are여야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: This puzzle is very harder than the last one.
It was in 2019 which we moved to Ulsan.
I don't know what was it that made her angry.
What on earth are you doing here?
items.exp: 의문사 강조 on earth가 옳아요. 비교급은 much로 강조하고, 강조의 does 뒤는 동사원형 look, 부사구 강조는 that, 간접의문문은 what it was that 어순이에요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: He did tell me the truth, but nobody believed him.
I am not in the least interested in his offer.
That's very the book I wanted to read.
She herself made this beautiful dress.
It was because of the rain that the game was canceled.
items.exp: 명사를 '바로 그'라고 강조할 때는 「the very+명사」 어순이므로 the very book으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: He does wants to see you again.
I didn't enjoy the movie in all.
It was my sister that she called me last night.
This box is more heavier than that one.
Why was it that she left the party so early?
items.exp: 의문사 강조 「의문사+was it that」이 옳아요. 강조의 does+동사원형 want, 부정 강조는 at all, that절에 주어 she가 중복, 비교급 강조는 much heavier로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It was at the library that I saw him yesterday.
(b) It is honesty that matters most in friendship.
(c) What was it that you wanted to tell me?
(d) I did finished my homework before dinner.
(e) She is even taller than her father.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부사구 강조 → that. (b) 옳음: 주어 honesty 강조. (c) 옳음: 의문사 강조 어순. (d) 틀림: 강조의 did 뒤 동사원형 finish. (e) 옳음: even은 비교급 강조. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Who on earth told you such a lie?
(b) He doesn't like vegetables at all.
(c) This is the very same mistake you made last time.
(d) It was Jenny and her brother who was waiting outside.
(e) She is much more confident than before.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 의문사 강조 on earth. (b) 옳음: 부정 강조 at all. (c) 옳음: the very same으로 강조. (d) 틀림: 강조된 Jenny and her brother(복수) → were. (e) 옳음: much는 비교급 강조. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It is in winter that this lake freezes.
(b) Where was it that you found the key?
(c) He does want to join the team.
(d) I fixed the bike me.
(e) The weather is so hotter than yesterday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부사구 강조. (b) 옳음: 의문사 강조 어순. (c) 옳음: 강조의 does+동사원형. (d) 틀림: 주어 강조는 재귀대명사 myself. (e) 틀림: 비교급은 so로 강조할 수 없어요 → much(far, even). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was the noise which woke me up.
(b) It was yesterday that the package arrived.
(c) It was my teacher which gave me this advice.
(d) I do hope you get well soon.
(e) They did tried their best.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 사물 강조는 that/which. (b) 옳음: 시간 부사 강조 → that. (c) 틀림: 사람 강조 → who(that). (d) 옳음: 강조의 do+동사원형. (e) 틀림: did 뒤 동사원형 try. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) You are the very person I wanted to see.
(b) What in the world happened here?
(c) I can't understand what is it that he wants.
(d) This lake is a lot deeper than it looks.
(e) It were the twins who won the race.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the very+명사. (b) 옳음: 의문사 강조 in the world. (c) 틀림: 간접의문문 → what it is that. (d) 옳음: a lot은 비교급 강조. (e) 틀림: 강조구문의 be동사는 항상 It is/was. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Do come and visit us again.
(b) It was because he was sick that he missed the class.
(c) It is the students which have to clean the classroom.
(d) The very thought of exams make me nervous.
(e) He is very more popular than his brother.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 명령문 강조 Do+동사원형. (b) 옳음: 부사절 강조. (c) 틀림: 사람 강조 → who(that). (d) 틀림: 주어 The very thought → makes. (e) 틀림: 비교급 강조 → much. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) It was in the kitchen ___ I found the cat.
(B) A: ___ was it that broke the vase? B: It was my little brother.
items.exp: (A) 부사구 in the kitchen을 강조하므로 that, (B) 대답이 사람(my little brother)이므로 Who was it that ~이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) This movie is ___ more exciting than the original.
(B) She ___ look tired yesterday.
(C) I'm not hungry ___.
items.exp: (A) 비교급 강조 much, (B) yesterday이므로 과거 강조 did, (C) 부정 강조 at all이에요. very는 비교급을, on earth는 부정문 끝을 강조하지 못해요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [It] was in Busan that we first met.
choices: [It] is important that you get enough sleep.
[It] was my brother that broke the window.
[It] is true that she moved to Seoul.
items.exp: <보기>는 It was와 that을 빼도 문장이 성립하는 강조구문이에요. 같은 것은 my brother를 강조한 문장이고, 나머지는 가주어 It이나 날씨의 비인칭 주어 It이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I [do] believe that you can win.
choices: He plays the piano better than I [do].
They [did] arrive on time after all.
items.exp: <보기>는 동사 believe를 강조하는 조동사 do예요. 같은 것은 arrive를 강조하는 did이고, 나머지는 일반동사 do, 대동사 do, 의문문을 만드는 조동사 do예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 그 지갑을 잃어버린 곳은 바로 그 버스 정류장이었다.
items.s: ___ that I lost the wallet.
a: It was at the bus stop
items.exp: 장소를 강조하는 강조구문이므로 It was 뒤에 전치사구 at the bus stop을 그대로 써야 해요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mina found the key under the sofa.
items.hint: under the sofa를 강조하는 It ~ that 문장으로
items.s: It was ___.
a: under the sofa that Mina found the key
items.exp: 강조할 부사구 under the sofa를 It was와 that 사이에 두고 나머지를 that 뒤에 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 강조의 의미를 살려 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She [did made] a mistake, but she fixed it quickly. → ___
items.exp: 강조의 조동사 did 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 did make예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: What is it that he wants?
items.hint: I don't know 뒤에 이어지는 간접의문문으로
items.s: I don't know ___.
a: what it is that he wants
items.exp: 의문사 강조 의문문을 간접의문문으로 바꾸면 「의문사+it is that ~」 어순이 돼요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어젯밤 그 창문을 깬 것은 바로 그 소년들이었다.
items.s: ___ the window last night.
a: It was the boys who broke
items.exp: 사람을 강조하므로 It was the boys who ~이고, 지난밤 일이므로 broke예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 두 다리는 저 오래된 다리보다 훨씬 더 길다.
items.s: These two bridges ___ than that old one.
items.exp: 주어가 복수이므로 are, 비교급 longer는 much로 강조해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: He likes not only playing soccer but also to watch it on TV.
The trip was long, tiring, and very expensive.
I'd rather stay home than go out tonight.
Whether you take the bus or walk, you'll get there in time.
items.exp: not only A but also B에서 A가 동명사 playing이므로 B도 watching으로 형태를 맞춰야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: While walked to school, I saw a rainbow.
The girl dancing on the stage are my sister.
He has to finish his homework and cleaning his room.
He didn't call me, and either did his friend.
items.exp: Though (she was) tired에서 주어와 be동사가 생략된 문장이 옳아요. While walking, 주어 The girl에 맞춘 is, to 뒤 finish와 병렬인 clean, 부정 동의는 neither did로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: My brother runs faster than I do.
You can go if you want to.
The book written in simple English were easy to read.
When asked about the plan, he said nothing.
The ears of a rabbit are longer than those of a cat.
items.exp: 분사구 written in simple English는 수식어이고 주어는 The book(단수)이므로 was여야 해요. want to는 반복되는 go를 생략한 대부정사로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: He is both smart and diligently.
The population of Seoul is larger than Busan.
She enjoys singing and to dance.
Reading books is as important as to exercise.
He told me to wait and not to leave.
items.exp: to wait와 not to leave가 to부정사로 병렬을 이루어 옳아요. smart와 같은 형용사 diligent, 비교 대상을 맞춘 that of Busan, 동명사 dancing, 주어 Reading과 같은 exercising으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Her advice was helpful, and his was too.
She came in, sat down, and opening her book.
If asked, I will tell the truth.
The man sitting next to me kept talking.
I like math better than science, and so does my brother.
items.exp: came, sat과 and로 연결되므로 opening이 아니라 과거동사 opened로 형태를 맞춰야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If possible, please reply by Friday.
(b) When cleaning the room, I found an old photo.
(c) The man standing at the door is my uncle.
(d) She works hard, and her husband does too.
(e) He was tired but happily.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: If (it is) possible의 생략. (b) 옳음: When (I was) cleaning의 생략, 주어 일치. (c) 옳음: who is 생략, 주어 The man → is. (d) 옳음: 대동사 does = works hard. (e) 틀림: tired와 병렬 → 형용사 happy. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He likes reading books rather than to watch TV.
(b) The prices in this store are higher than those in that store.
(c) Not only the price but also the quality are important.
(d) Some students went home, and others to the library.
(e) Although injured, he finished the race.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: reading과 병렬 → watching. (b) 옳음: 복수 the prices → those. (c) 틀림: B(the quality)에 맞춰 is. (d) 옳음: 반복되는 went 생략. (e) 옳음: Although (he was) injured의 생략. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) My father drinks more coffee than my mother does.
(b) The letter sent to me yesterday was from my aunt.
(c) He asked me to come, but I didn't want.
(d) The boy found a wallet and taking it to the police.
(e) Once finished, the painting will be shown in the museum.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 대동사 does = drinks. (b) 옳음: which was 생략, 주어 The letter → was. (c) 틀림: 대부정사 to가 필요 → didn't want to. (d) 틀림: found와 병렬 → took. (e) 옳음: Once (it is) finished의 생략. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The weather in July is hotter than that in May.
(b) He opened the window and let the fresh air in.
(c) She would rather walk than taking a taxi.
(d) Leaving alone, the puppy began to cry.
(e) Look at the boy and the dog that are running.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the weather → that. (b) 옳음: opened와 과거형 let 병렬. (c) 틀림: would rather A than B → take. (d) 틀림: 강아지가 '혼자 남겨진' 것 → Left alone. (e) 옳음: 사람+동물 선행사 → that, 복수 are. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) When young, he lived on a farm.
(b) The houses built last year look modern.
(c) She can speak French and writes it well.
(d) My bag is heavier than yours.
(e) The students waited for the bus, talking and laugh.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: When (he was) young의 생략. (b) 옳음: which were 생략, 주어 The houses → look. (c) 틀림: can 뒤 speak와 병렬 → write. (d) 옳음: yours = your bag. (e) 틀림: talking과 병렬 → laughing. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I asked him to sit down and relax.
(b) While waiting for the bus, it started to rain.
(c) The tallest of the three boys is my cousin.
(d) Her voice is softer than her sister.
(e) He doesn't like cats, nor does he like dogs.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: to sit와 (to) relax 병렬. (b) 틀림: 생략된 주어와 주절 주어 it이 달라 쓸 수 없어요 → While I was waiting ~. (c) 옳음: 주어 The tallest → is. (d) 틀림: 목소리끼리 비교 → her sister's. (e) 옳음: nor 뒤 도치. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She enjoys cooking and ___ new recipes.
(B) He decided to quit his job and ___ abroad.
items.exp: (A) enjoy의 목적어 cooking과 병렬이므로 trying, (B) to quit과 병렬인 (to) study에서 to가 생략된 동사원형 study예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) When ___ by her friends, she smiled.
(B) The cars ___ in Korea are popular abroad.
(C) My room is bigger than ___.
items.exp: (A) When (she was) praised의 수동, (B) 자동차가 '만들어진' 것이므로 made, (C) 방끼리 비교하므로 my brother's (room)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The streets of Paris are wider than ___ of London.
(B) I didn't go to the concert, but my sister ___.
items.exp: (A) 복수 명사 The streets를 받으므로 those, (B) 앞의 일반동사 went to the concert를 대신하므로 대동사 did예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 질문을 받았을 때, 그녀는 미소만 지었다.
items.hint: When 뒤에 주어와 be동사를 생략, (ask) 활용, 4단어
items.s: ___, she only smiled.
items.exp: When she was asked the question에서 주절과 같은 주어와 be동사를 생략하고, '질문을 받은' 것이므로 과거분사 asked를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She likes hiking, swimming, and [to ride] a bike. → ___
items.exp: hiking, swimming과 and로 연결되므로 동명사 riding으로 형태를 맞춰요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The population of Tokyo is larger than [Seoul]. → ___
items.exp: 도시가 아니라 인구끼리 비교하므로 the population을 받는 that of Seoul(Seoul's)로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 공원에서 놀고 있는 아이들은 내 조카들이다.
items.s: The children ___ my nephews.
items.exp: who are가 생략된 현재분사구 playing in the park가 The children을 꾸미고, 주어가 복수이므로 are예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내 남동생은 나보다 더 많은 책을 읽는다.
items.s: My brother ___.
a: reads more books than I do
items.exp: 반복되는 read books를 대동사 do로 받고, 주어 My brother에 맞춰 reads를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어제 그는 집에 와서 샤워를 하고 잠자리에 들었다.
items.s: Yesterday he ___ to bed.
a: came home, took a shower, and went
came home, took a shower and went
items.exp: 세 동작이 and로 병렬 연결되므로 모두 과거형 came, took, went로 형태를 맞춰요.
